## Commonsense Corner:
---

subject: Greg Abbott is threatening to take over Houston’s elections
body:
This isn’t about election integrity. It’s about power.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Hi Peter,
Gerrymandering our state wasn’t enough — now Greg Abbott is threatening to take over Harris County elections.
This week, Abbott claimed Harris County should be “stripped” of running elections, with the state stepping in instead.
This isn’t about election integrity. It’s about power.
Abbott knows he’s one of the most unpopular politicians in Texas, and he can feel Texans turning on him, so he’s trying to tighten his grip on the election process instead of earning people’s votes.
And he’s doing all of this while costs are skyrocketing for Texans because he’s selling us out to his billionaire donors.
Texans deserve better than a governor who tries to rig the rules when he can’t win fairly.

name: John Fetterman
subject: it's the best time of the year 🚜
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
[ https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/51612?refcode=jtk318-fr-fl-header&t=1001&akid=10534%2E434096%2Eo69e19 ]John Fetterman

Hey, folks – it’s John.

The PA Farm Show is in full swing, so I wanted to take a moment to tip my hat to the folks who make it happen.

Whether you're showing livestock or working behind the scenes to make sure the exhibitions go on without a glitch, thanks for all you do, and best of luck the rest of this week! 🍀

If you haven’t gone yet, try to get there by Saturday. It’s one of the best ways to see what makes PA so special. And be sure to check out this year’s butter sculpture – here’s a throwback to when we had Butter Gritty.

It's more important than ever that we support the hardworking folks across our state who work day in and day out to put food on tables across our state and our country.

That's why, as a member of the Senate Ag Committee, I’m fighting to make sure our farmers have what they need to be successful.

That means I’m working to:

🛑 Stop Trump’s illegal USDA cuts
🌾 Invest in organic research and science
🥚 Make egg labels honest
🍄 Protect mushroom farmers
🥪 And get kids healthy meals

And I'm proud to say that right before the holidays, Congress passed my bipartisan Whole Milk for Healthy Kids Act, and now it's on its way to the president's desk for signature.

In this day and age, Big Ag loves to squeeze out small farmers and rural communities. But I'm going to keep doing everything in my power to support our farmers. If there's one thing you can count on, it's this: I have our farmers' backs. 💯

If you agree our farmers are a massive part of what makes PA what it is, and they deserve 100% of our support in their fight against Big Ag, you can click here to pitch in a few bucks to keep up the fight.

https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/52538?t=1002&akid=10534%2E434096%2Eo69e19

Thanks, folks – and I hope you get a chance to enjoy the Farm Show.

John ❤️

Charlie wrote this book because he knew what America was missing... and what he nearly lost himself.

He found that in a world addicted to busyness, noise, and scrolling...

_**The most radical act of resistance is to STOP. **_

To rest. To reflect. To return to God.

This book is his blueprint for how we do that -- as individuals, as families, and as a nation.

🔥 You'll discover how Charlie learned to honor the Sabbath in a culture that never stops

🔥 How setting aside just one day a week gave him clarity, peace, and strength

🔥 Why he believed this message could spark a spiritual revival across America

I know he would've wanted you to have this book.

**When you give today to Turning Point USA, you 're not just supporting the movement Charlie built -- you're helping pass on the message he felt most urgently in his final months. **

clean_body: In a world that never stops, Charlie did Charlie Kirk’s final book on Sabbath rest—make a gift to TPUSA and we’ll send you a copy. | | Peter, Charlie Kirk built a movement for truth -- but his final message pointed to something eternal. It wasn't about politics... or elections... or even about the culture war. His final book was deeply personal, and unlike anything Charlie had written before... It was about the Sabbath. About sacred rest. Reconnecting with God. Charlie wrote this book because he knew what America was missing... and what he nearly lost himself. He found that in a world addicted to busyness, noise, and scrolling... The most radical act of resistance is to STOP. To rest. To reflect. To return to God. This book is his blueprint for how we do that -- as individuals, as families, and as a nation. 🔥 You'll discover how Charlie learned to honor the Sabbath in a culture that never stops 🔥 How setting aside just one day a week gave him clarity, peace, and strength 🔥 Why he believed this message could spark a spiritual revival across America I know he would've wanted you to have this book. When you give today to Turning Point USA, you 're not just supporting the movement Charlie built -- you're helping pass on the message he felt most urgently in his final months. Peter, thank you, in advance, for helping reach the next generation with truth, faith, and moral courage -- the very things Charlie gave his life for. And as you do, may the message of this book lead you -- just as it led Charlie -- to a deeper trust in God, a stronger love for your family, and a renewed peace in your own soul. For Charlie, Justin Streiff Chief Operating Officer Turning Point USA P.S. subject: A new generation in Maryland
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
Let’s show the doubters what people-power looks like.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260112-1&t=1&akid=3040%2E587540%2EhDXgIy)
Peter,
I want to tell you about someone I worked with in the trenches of the gun violence prevention movement, who’s now running to be the youngest member of the Maryland legislature: Matt Post.
I’m going to share more about Matt below, but if you’re ready to support his candidacy now, **[will you split a $5 contribution to his campaign and Leaders We Deserve?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260112_1_post.e1lDBM&refcode=em20260112-3040&amount=5&t=2&akid=3040%2E587540%2EhDXgIy)**
At March For Our Lives, Matt started our legal team, fighting the gun lobby in courts across the country as a champion for common-sense gun safety laws. We worked side by side to defend universal background checks, bans on open carry on college campuses, and getting 3D printed guns off our streets.
As long as I’ve known Matt, he’s been fighting for a better Maryland. He fought for public schools as a member of his Board of Education and today he works as a labor attorney for the Maryland teachers’ union, standing up for the pay and dignity of teachers, bus drivers, and school staff.
Now, Matt is running to bring that same urgency to the Maryland statehouse and represent his hometown. And Leaders We Deserve is proud to be endorsing him.
But the insiders in Maryland are watching his race closely and skeptically. Can a Gen-Z candidate build a winning campaign without taking a cent from corporations?
Let’s show the doubters what people-power looks like.
**[Would you consider making a $5 donation — split between Matt’s campaign and Leaders We Deserve — to help elect a Gen-Z legislator in Maryland and across the country?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260112_1_post.e1lDBM&refcode=em20260112-3040&amount=5&t=3&akid=3040%2E587540%2EhDXgIy)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260112_1_post.e1lDBM&amount=5&refcode=em20260112-3040&t=22&akid=3040%2E587540%2EhDXgIy)**
We need legislators who understand what it means to grow up in underfunded classrooms under the constant threat of gun violence. We need leaders who refuse to sit by while another generation watches the sea levels rise, housing become unaffordable, and their rights rolled back.
That future won’t build itself. It’s going to take Americans from every generation coming together. And it starts with races like this one. I’m grateful to be in this fight with leaders like Matt — and supporters like you.
Thank you for believing in this new generation of leadership.
David

There comes a point in every man’s life when you wonder how history will remember you.
---
No matter what happens in my RIGGED trial, I know with absolute confidence that history will say: **_“Rudy W. Giuliani was a fighter.”_**

**I fought the Mafia, I fought violent criminals, I fought corruption, I fought the Deep State agents who tried to frame and destroy my client – President Trump.**

_Now, at 81 years old, rather than fighting for someone else’s freedom and justice, I find myself fighting for my** _own_**._

**That’s why I officially filed a NEW _Defense_ _Trust_ in the conservative-friendly state of Florida that will give me _more power_ to fight the Left’s FINAL attempt to imprison me for LIFE.**

_Peter, I am going to be brutally honest with you: right now, I lack the necessary means to fully fund my Defense Trust. Trust me, admitting that is not my strong suit._

_I’m going up against the machine that let James Comey and Letitia James off the hook – the machine that had me and the President ARRESTED in the most violent jail in America._
---
With your help, history will forever remember that we took on the machine – and _WON_!

Fellow Patriot,

The Republican House majority is hanging by a thread. It’s one of the slimmest margins in modern history, and if we lose even a handful of seats, Democrats take the gavel back.

**If that happens, everything stops.**

No border security. No accountability. Just investigations, obstruction, and nonstop attacks on President Trump and the America First agenda. We’ve seen this movie before—and it ends badly.

I’m Mark Lamb, former Sheriff of Pinal County, Arizona. I spent years dealing with the consequences of Washington’s failures firsthand. Open borders aren’t theoretical to me. They mean drug trafficking, human trafficking, and communities paying the price while politicians in D.C. do nothing.

_That’s why I’m running for Congress._

This race matters nationally. Border security affects every state. The House majority affects every issue. **And the truth is, Democrats absolutely could flip the House if Republicans don’t get serious right now.**

**President Donald Trump endorsed this campaign because he knows I won’t fold, cave, or play games. I’ll fight for secure borders, law and order, and putting American citizens first.**

clean_body: | Fellow Patriot, The Republican House majority is hanging by a thread. It’s one of the slimmest margins in modern history, and if we lose even a handful of seats, Democrats take the gavel back. If that happens, everything stops. No border security. No accountability. Just investigations, obstruction, and nonstop attacks on President Trump and the America First agenda. We’ve seen this movie before—and it ends badly. I’m Mark Lamb, former Sheriff of Pinal County, Arizona. I spent years dealing with the consequences of Washington’s failures firsthand. Open borders aren’t theoretical to me. They mean drug trafficking, human trafficking, and communities paying the price while politicians in D.C. do nothing. That’s why I’m running for Congress. This race matters nationally. Border security affects every state. The House majority affects every issue. And the truth is, Democrats absolutely could flip the House if Republicans don’t get serious right now. President Donald Trump endorsed this campaign because he knows I won’t fold, cave, or play games. I’ll fight for secure borders, law and order, and putting American citizens first. But with margins this tight, winning takes more than endorsements. It takes a strong grassroots effort—and that starts now. Thank you for standing with me and for standing up for this country. Derek,
My name is Mary Peltola, and I want to share with you why I've made the decision to run for the United States Senate in Alaska — and to ask for your support as we begin this journey together.
But if you already understand how important this race and your support are, and you’re ready to become a Founding Donor to our campaign, please use this link to split a contribution today:
[**secure.actblue.com/donate/q12026_abs_em_peltola/founding-donor**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=q12026_abs_em_peltola.4RcE7O&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20260112_AM2_V1_S1&t=4&akid=9407%2E5257348%2E99lXX-)

---
Now here’s a bit more on how I came to this decision.
When I was growing up in Bethel, salmon fishing with my father in the summers and dog mushing in the winters, Alaska was a place of abundance.
Now, all across Alaska, we have scarcity.
Multi-national companies are trawling our waters and decimating our fish stocks. The moose, caribou, and migratory birds that used to fill our freezers are harder to find.
So we buy more groceries, where the prices are just _crushing_ Alaska families.
And I've got to tell you, DC people do not care that we are paying 17 bucks for a gallon of milk. _They don’t even believe us._
They're focused on their own wallets — not ours.
And when they actually work together on something, it’s usually to help themselves. The rigged system in DC is shutting down Alaska and hurting all of us while politicians and their millionaire and billionaire donors feather their own nest.
It’s why our prices are rising, and our heating bills keep going up. All while the health care and services Alaskans rely on get gutted.
I'm done with politicians getting richer while things get tougher here at home.
Systemic change is the only way to bring down grocery costs, save our fisheries, lower energy prices, and build new housing Alaskans can actually afford.
Systemic change is the only way to fill our homes with abundance again.
My agenda for Alaska will always be: fish, family, freedom. These values have been the core values of my campaigns since the very beginning.
But if we’re going to secure Alaska’s future, we need another priority: fighting corruption.
I'm running for Alaska's Senate seat because it is the fight for our future.
**This is going to be one of the closest Senate races of the next election, and I cannot do this alone. There is only one way we’ll be able to win this race... and that is together.**
So I am asking:
[**Please contribute to my campaign for the U.S. Senate and Adam Schiff today to become a Founding Donor. We are looking for a huge number of day one donors to get our campaign off to a strong start and put us in a position to win. No donation is too small. ---
Hi Derek,
This is Erin Conway, the DNC’s Grassroots Fundraising Director. I oversee our entire grassroots fundraising operation (which includes approving messages like this one!).
And if there’s one thing I know for sure, it’s that when a big election year begins, campaigns and organizations ramp up the number of messages they’re sending.
So I’ll be transparent with you: We know that you might be on other lists that send panicked, scammy emails trying to scare you into giving money. They might treat you like their own personal ATM. The closer we get to the midterms, the more the scare tactics will increase.
**So we wanted to send a quick reminder of what we believe at the DNC:**
* You are the backbone of our organization’s work, **_but you are not an ATM machine._** We know that this work only happens when our team believes in it, and we make that our top priority.
* We don’t want you to feel intimidated into donating. We want to provide information about the work your money powers that makes you _want_ to join us.
* We don’t expect you to donate to every email we send, so we do our best to provide accurate and up-to-date information about our work so that you can make the most informed decision possible before donating your hard-earned money to this cause.

So Derek, here’s the topline:
The DNC is the organization best positioned to distribute resources when and where they’re needed most.
We send money to candidates and state parties across the Democratic ecosystem, and our main priority is to elect Democrats up and down the ballot and in every corner of the country who will fight to make life easier and more affordable for _all_ Americans.
Members of our team are experts in what they do, and spend their time at the DNC strategizing to organize, fight, and win across the country.
Our fundraising goals are set intentionally to ensure that we have the resources to continue that work.
[**When you receive an email from the DNC asking for your support, we hope you remember it was written and sent with these beliefs in mind. Your contribution today will help us make early investments in key states, scale up our organizing efforts, and ensure Democrats across the country have the resources to work towards winning the midterms in November.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-january-2026?amount=7&refcode=em_20250112_5764_fr&refcode2=5764_22930333_SB1Rur&akid=5764%2E22930333%2ESB1Rur)

name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: Two ICE shootings. Two cities. One media playbook.
body:
Plus: A Venezuelan guard describes what 20 US soldiers did to hundreds of them. | New for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=e428375ff8&e=567664f14c)
| | | | | |
[Two ICE-related shootings this week. Two cities. Same media playbook.](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=480d80ee86&e=567664f14c) In Minneapolis, a woman spent the morning blocking ICE agents. When they told her to get out of her car, she didn't. She accelerated. An agent fired. She died. In Portland, Border Patrol confronted two people in a vehicle. They tried to run over the agents. Agents fired. Both survived. The media told you one version. **We have the real story.**
---
[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=565b709f30&e=567664f14c)
| |
🎭 **CNN CALLED THEM A "MARRIED COUPLE"**
That's how CNN framed the Portland shooting. A married couple. Shot by Border Patrol. No other context.
Turns out they were Tren de Aragua gang members — the violent Venezuelan gang. They were connected to a prior shooting. They had active criminal cases.
The Portland police chief got up and admitted all of it.
Then he started crying. And apologizing to the Latino community.
We play the clip.

📢 **JAKE TAPPER'S DANGEROUS QUESTION**
Back to Minneapolis. A woman is dead after blocking and then accelerating toward ICE agents. Jake Tapper's response? He sat across from DHS Secretary Kristi Noem and questioned whether the agent could really know she meant him harm.
This is what a "permission structure" looks like. Media coverage that tells people they can confront federal agents — and if something goes wrong, the agent was the problem.
We break down exactly how this works — and why it's going to happen again.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=3fc534f82b&e=567664f14c)
---
| |
🇻🇪 **20 SOLDIERS. HUNDREDS OF GUARDS. ZERO AMERICAN CASUALTIES.**
Two weeks ago, US forces captured Venezuelan dictator Nicolás Maduro in a surgical military strike.
Now a Venezuelan security guard is talking about what he saw.
He describes a weapon that made them bleed from the nose. Vomit blood. Collapse. Unable to stand.
20 American soldiers took on hundreds of guards. Not a single US casualty.
We also play a clip of a Delta Force operator on Rogan. His advice to cartel members if the US comes for them? "Retire. Buy a restaurant. Go legit."
After Venezuela, nobody's laughing.

🇮🇷 **IRAN ON THE BRINK**
The Iranian people are rising up against the regime. Thousands protesting. Hundreds may be dead. The government cut the internet. Starlink is keeping some information flowing.
The Crown Prince — exiled for decades — appealed directly to Trump on Fox News.
If this tips, it changes the Middle East forever.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=94ad44f5f7&e=567664f14c)
---
| |
🍎 **THE FOOD PYRAMID GOT FLIPPED**
Old advice: Low fat. 6-11 servings of grains.
New reality: Whole foods. Protein. Natural fats.
Marty Makary said it plainly: "We created a generation of children with sugar addiction. And what did we do? Drugged them at scale."
We talk about what this means for our own kids.

📚 **MISSISSIPPI: 49TH → 9TH IN READING**
Rahm Emanuel — Democrat, former Chicago mayor — went to Mississippi to learn how they jumped from 49th to 9th in reading.
Phonics. Reading coaches. And they stayed the course — didn't abandon it when the governor changed.
New Mexico started down the same path under Susanna Martinez. Then MLG came in and dropped it.
We break down what happened — and what it's costing our kids.

name: Survey Team @ Our Revolution
subject: Should we break the oligarchs’ hold on our democracy?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Our Revolution click here to unsubscribe
body:
[ stdin# ]Our Revolution Logo

Peter Willis,

2026 has arrived – and so has our chance to take back power, defeat Trump
and his billionaire backers, and restore our democracy.

But to win, this movement has told us time and time again that the first
thing we need to do is confront the core rot in our politics: the
oligarchs and corporate elites who have flooded our elections with dark
money, bought politicians on both sides, and rigged the system to line
their own pockets.

As we lean into the fight to take on Trump and his oligarchs and get dark
and corporate money out of our politics, Our Revolution is launching a
massive grassroots survey to guide our work and show elected officials
and the media what issues are most activating and energizing our base. Can
you take a quick minute to tell us what you think?

Here’s the first question:

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34929?source=email-20260112&t=1011&akid=10073%2E5885482%2EYTyEnu ]How concerned are you about the Oligarchy – as a threat to democracy,
as damaging to Americans’ economic wellbeing, and as a force of corruption
politically, socially and economically?

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34929?source=email-20260112&t=1012&akid=10073%2E5885482%2EYTyEnu ]Very concerned

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34929?source=email-20260112&t=1013&akid=10073%2E5885482%2EYTyEnu ]Somewhat concerned

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34929?source=email-20260112&t=1014&akid=10073%2E5885482%2EYTyEnu ]Unsure

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34929?source=email-20260112&t=1015&akid=10073%2E5885482%2EYTyEnu ]Not concerned

Survey after survey – including an independent academic study of Our
Revolution supporters – show that an overwhelming majority of us believe
that defunding the oligarchs and getting billionaire money out of politics
MUST be our top priorities – and that we must only back candidates who are
willing to take bold action against oligarchs.

This movement is crystal clear: without leaders willing to break the
billionaire stranglehold, we can’t achieve Medicare for All, living wages,
or climate justice.

That’s why Our Revolution is working around the clock to take down the
oligarchy. Every single day we’re pushing to get billionaire money out of
elections, cancel federal contracts for oligarchs, end tax breaks for the
ultra-wealthy, crack down on crypto crooks, and shut down the
billionaire-backed surveillance state.

Because we know it’s not enough to oppose Trump – we must cut off the
billionaires feeding his movement. If we don’t, the same handful of
billionaires will control both parties – our futures, our planet, and
every progressive priority we fight for. But if millions of us stand up
together, we can make unprecedented demands and make 2026 the year we
break the oligarchs’ hold on our democracy.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34929?source=email-20260112&t=1016&akid=10073%2E5885482%2EYTyEnu ]That’s why we need to hear from you again. The media, party insiders,
and potential candidates are all watching. Let’s show them where the
energy is: will you take our quick survey now and tell us what you think?

When we organize, we win,

Our Revolution

body:

Let me level with you, Peter:
This is one of the last fundraising emails you’ll get from me for a while. **Our Republican opponents don’t have that restriction.** They’ll be out there raising money like it’s their full-time job, lining up dark-money groups and preparing to pour millions into Maryland to try to flip this seat.
Now, I don’t love asking for money. You’ve probably figured that out by now. But what we raise in the last days before the fundraising freeze will determine if we can keep our campaign competitive.
I made a promise to never be beholden to special interests, and I’m able to keep that promise because supporters like you keep showing up for us.
**[So before you see a lot less of me in your inbox, will you chip in $10 or $25 today?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260112-3.ukEL6L&refcode=em-20260112-3&t=3&akid=1205%2E1086043%2EheZErR)**

Wes

Too often, Michigan is overlooked. Counted out. Written off by people in Washington.

That’s why I’m running: to make sure the voices of Michiganders are heard.

So when I talk about lowering grocery prices, supporting Michigan manufacturing, or protecting your health care, it’s personal. I hear your worries, and I’m ready to fight like heck for you.

Peter,
---
Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn't a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal -- the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God's grace. **

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**" God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." **_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.

| | | | | | Dear Peter,What’s happening right now in America is a breakdown of lawful oversight, and Congress is not treating it with the seriousness it demands.ICE is conducting raids that stretch far beyond statutory authority, unchecked in their hate, greenlighted to intimidate, kidnap, and murder.
Federal agencies like ICE, DHS, and other task forces are utilizing wartime tactics in American communities. People are dying with no independent inquiry, hearings, subpoenas, or consequences.
As the nation shifts to authoritarianism, martial enforcement will become permanent.
This means:
* Expanded military force traditionally reserved for wartime action
* Reduced transparency
* Rapid, sweeping operations that bypass normal oversight
* Minimal judicial review or due process
* Enforcement actions that feel occupation-like rather than community-based

In other words, we are now encroaching towards the reality of martial enforcement without a formal martial law declaration. Amidst all of this, Congress has done nothing to meaningfully investigate or provide a structural challenge to this unchecked executive power, which the Republicans support.
Republicans have abandoned the Constitution out of cowardice and loyalty to Trump. And too many Democrats have stayed silent.
That is why I’m running for Congress.
Someone must confront federal agencies as if the Constitution actually matters.
My mandate is straightforward:
* Compel investigations into unlawful or extralegal federal enforcement actions
* Force transparency from agencies that have operated without it
* Reinstate congressional authority over detention, due process, and use-of-force protocols
* Hold leadership accountable when civil rights violations occur, immediately

If Congress refuses to do its job, then new leadership must. That is what this campaign stands for.
[**If you believe Congress should confront abuse of power, join me. Every day that Congress stays silent, our rights slip further away.**](https://chrisahuja.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=67424df89870d1cac00e55f46&id=82ed16b507&e=53c7d12fc7)
I’m ready to hold them accountable.

clean_body: We deserve responsible leadership in Congress | | | | | | | | | | | Dear Peter,What’s happening right now in America is a breakdown of lawful oversight, and Congress is not treating it with the seriousness it demands.ICE is conducting raids that stretch far beyond statutory authority, unchecked in their hate, greenlighted to intimidate, kidnap, and murder. Federal agencies like ICE, DHS, and other task forces are utilizing wartime tactics in American communities. People are dying with no independent inquiry, hearings, subpoenas, or consequences. As the nation shifts to authoritarianism, martial enforcement will become permanent. This means: Expanded military force traditionally reserved for wartime action Reduced transparency Rapid, sweeping operations that bypass normal oversight Minimal judicial review or due process Enforcement actions that feel occupation-like rather than community-based In other words, we are now encroaching towards the reality of martial enforcement without a formal martial law declaration. Amidst all of this, Congress has done nothing to meaningfully investigate or provide a structural challenge to this unchecked executive power, which the Republicans support. Republicans have abandoned the Constitution out of cowardice and loyalty to Trump. And too many Democrats have stayed silent. That is why I’m running for Congress. Someone must confront federal agencies as if the Constitution actually matters. My mandate is straightforward: Compel investigations into unlawful or extralegal federal enforcement actions Force transparency from agencies that have operated without it Reinstate congressional authority over detention, due process, and use-of-force protocols Hold leadership accountable when civil rights violations occur, immediately If Congress refuses to do its job, then new leadership must. That is what this campaign stands for. body:
I've been having nightmares recently that are dark beyond description. Terrifying. One occurred at 3:30 in the morning on the day that Charlie was killed. In one nightmare, a landline phone next to my bed rang. I answered, and on the other end was some demon, the most haunting voice I've heard in my life, saying, "I'm in your basement."

| | [****](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6jb6a81nh2rlqjqea9ui8pcg8stnjrhp7bp27d8_rp22sh2s8i6eor0spg6co76cdh2bs) [****](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zjglr1jv1bbsc1qs70ph1pm3e9ttf7npr7irqkb8_rp22sh2s8i6eor0spg6co76cdh2bs) Dear Patriot,

I've been having nightmares recently that are dark beyond description. Terrifying. One occurred at 3:30 in the morning on the day that Charlie was killed.

In one nightmare, a landline phone next to my bed rang. I answered, and on the other end was **some demon** , the most haunting voice I've heard in my life, saying, "**I'm in your basement.** "

I sat up immediately, not knowing if it was real or a dream. My hands ran alongside my bed to feel the fabric in the darkness. It took some time to recognize that I was awake. I looked at my nightstand, and there was no phone.

Those who know much more about God and the Devil than I do say that this is an example of spiritual warfare. They tell me that it's meant to terrify me, to make me question myself and my own sanity. **These nightmares, this evil, come just before a story OMG will be breaking that I believe will expose evil in a way we've never seen before**.

The story was placed on hold due to the shock and grief we've all felt for Charlie Kirk. I used to run stories by Charlie to get his feedback. I relayed our next release to Charlie before he was shot. It was the last text Charlie Kirk ever sent me. I prefer to keep the message private, but he understood the significance of the story and that **it strikes at the heart of evil in our nation.**

I'm reluctant to "hype" stories anymore. That's not my intent. But I am asking for your help.

First, I'm humbly asking for your prayers for me and OMG's staff. If you're a believer, I don't need to say anything else, other than "thank you."

Secondly, [**your support is needed**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2tp646lcg1p45l7lnuenjp93117gcvr89141uq0_rp22sh2s8i6eor0spg6co76cdh2bs). [**Any amount that you can contribute is appreciated**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zgg8jf7lf1fjdl9td8u9ft0jfknljintsp5m0ue8_rp22sh2s8i6eor0spg6co76cdh2bs).

This story was one of our least expensive to produce, and you'll see why when it comes out. But it will open the floodgates of truth, and we need to be prepared for that. This story has the potential to change the world, but that's not up to me. OMG, reports the truth, the world decides. But I would be negligent in my duties if we're not prepared to deal with a flood of high-level whistleblowers after this release. And that's where your support is needed. [**Please, donate whatever you can today**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvat0q68sj4h9jo3sc0s37bmouigg55i3lgven70_rp22sh2s8i6eor0spg6co76cdh2bs).

Thank you again for all that you do and, as always, stay tuned.

In Truth, James O'Keefe
Founder and CEO
O'Keefe Media Group

Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud.

| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdmbi5mlhh3b2i582e0nk8cict5sh0q5ocu25378_rp22sh2s8i6eor0spi68o32c3h2bs)

It wasn't about politics... or elections... or even about the culture war.

His final book was deeply personal, and unlike anything Charlie had written before...

**It was about the Sabbath. **

About sacred rest. Reconnecting with God.
---

---
Charlie wrote this book because he knew what America was missing... and what he nearly lost himself.

He found that in a world addicted to busyness, noise, and scrolling...

_**The most radical act of resistance is to STOP. **_

To rest. To reflect. To return to God.

This book is his blueprint for how we do that -- as individuals, as families, and as a nation.

🔥 You'll discover how Charlie learned to honor the Sabbath in a culture that never stops
🔥 How setting aside just one day a week gave him clarity, peace, and strength
🔥 Why he believed this message could spark a spiritual revival across America

I know he would've wanted you to have this book.

**When you give today to Turning Point USA, you 're not just supporting the movement Charlie built -- you're helping pass on the message he felt most urgently in his final months. **

**Justin Streiff **

Hoosiers are safer today thanks to decisive action to crack down on drugs and dangerous driving, while bold investments are positioning Indiana at the forefront of national security and advanced technology. From removing opioids from our streets to earning a nationally designated drone testing site, Governor Braun is proving that Indiana can lead--protecting families today while building opportunity for the future.As President Trump takes decisive action to protect the homeland and dismantle international narco-terror networks, Indiana Republicans have begun the legislative session with an agenda focused on lowering costs, cutting red tape, and keeping Indiana one of the fastest-growing states in the country. With candidate filing now open and the 2026 election cycle underway, Republicans are preparing to take this record to voters, showing Hoosiers that American first leadership delivers safer communities, a stronger economy, and a government that works for the people.As always, thank you for being a part of our team, and please feel free to reach out if there's any way I can be of assistance.Yours in service, Lana Keesling, Indiana GOP Chairwoman _**Governor Braun, Indiana State Police Keep Hoosiers Safe**_ One year into Governor Braun's administration, Indiana witnessed a 117% increase in opioid seizures, a 60% decrease in overdose deaths, a 17% increase in OWI arrests, and an 8.3% decrease in statewide fatal crashes._" One of our top priorities is to ensure Hoosiers have a safe place to raise their families. Thanks to the incredible work of the Indiana State Police, who have gone above and beyond to remove drugs from the streets and impaired drivers from the roads, Indiana is a safer place. I want to thank them and all our Hoosier law enforcement for all they do to protect our communities and families.__"_ \- Governor Braun via a [press release](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-azaly-hhlljjcji-r/) _**Governor Braun Secures National Drone Test Site Designation for Indiana, Leading in White House Initiative for American Drone Dominance**_ Governor Braun's effort to position Indiana to lead in American drone technology saw a massive win this week, with Indiana being chosen as one of two states to win a designated national drone testing site, making Indiana one of the first new UAS testing grounds in nearly a decade._" Indiana is taking a leading role in President Trump's mission to unleash American drone dominance. Dear Reader,

The U.S. national debt just crossed $38 trillion... and a couple months ago it was $37 trillion.

That's right - the US added a TRILLION dollars in a matter of weeks.

That's the fastest rate of debt growth outside the pandemic.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ff5f9adc6a786196a57363e48d1b810eb49cccf1eb44a843de28bda377ea3b74a94f6de50049306fa11cada504be019be28ac7f7d3ae20dc1ba52fa18bc02eaa

No war... no crisis... just spending.

And you are paying 3.35% average interest on that debt... which means over $1.2 trillion a year... just on interest.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ff5f9adc6a786196a57363e48d1b810eb49cccf1eb44a843de28bda377ea3b74a94f6de50049306fa11cada504be019be28ac7f7d3ae20dc1ba52fa18bc02eaa

More than defense.

More than Medicare.

And here's the thing... the taxpayers are paying interest with MORE borrowed money.

JPMorgan just warned we're at 120% debt-to-GDP... and we're headed to 156% by 2055.

Now... think about this - Greece was at 130% when their economy collapsed.

What happened to the Greeks?

Pensions cut by 40%.

Bank accounts frozen.

ATMs limited to 60 euros per day... retirement savings obliterated overnight.

And I bet you didn't know this - the Fed is worse off than Greece right now.

Why? Because they're simply... trapped.

To put it simply... inflation is still sitting at 3.1 percent while the Fed wants it at 2.

So if they cut rates, inflation heats up again.

If they keep rates high, the national debt sinks the country even faster.

And Yale's Budget Lab just showed that when federal debt rises... inflation and interest rates rise together.

Which means your mortgage... your car loan... your credit cards...

They're all getting more expensive because the government is trapped.

Now, countries like Greece were able to reset their currency when things blew up.

The U.S. can't do that because the entire world depends on the dollar... and if THAT breaks, everything breaks with it.

All three major credit rating agencies downgraded U.S. debt... and is no longer AAA rated anywhere.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ff5f9adc6a786196a57363e48d1b810eb49cccf1eb44a843de28bda377ea3b74a94f6de50049306fa11cada504be019be28ac7f7d3ae20dc1ba52fa18bc02eaa

That's never happened before in modern history.

And gold? Just hit $4,000 per ounce... up over 50% from last year.

Because smart money is getting out of dollars.

Have you ever thought about what that means for you?

401(k)? Built on that dollar.

Retirement? Built on that dollar.

Savings? Losing value every single day.

That's exactly why I created this

Giving you access to hedged returns that beat any traditional asset out there.

| Police Officers Association of Michigan Endorses Doug Lloyd for Attorney General
Pre-Convention endorsement underscores that prosecutorial experience wins statewide elections
LANSING, MI - Doug Lloyd, candidate for Michigan Attorney General, today announced the endorsement of the Police Officers Association of Michigan (POAM), a leading organization representing law enforcement professionals across the state.
The endorsement comes ahead of the Republican endorsement convention and highlights the strength of Lloyd's prosecutorial background in a race that will ultimately be decided by voters statewide. POAM represents law enforcement employees throughout Michigan and advocates for public safety, economic security, and strong support for those who protect Michigan communities.
"As a prosecutor, I've worked side by side with law enforcement to hold violent offenders accountable and keep communities safe," said Doug Lloyd. "This endorsement shows that experience matters and that prosecutors with a record of enforcing the law can win in a general election. Michigan needs an Attorney General who understands the job from day one."
[Lloyd has already earned the endorsement of more than 60 county prosecutors, over 30 sheriffs, and dozens of retired judges, prosecutors, and sheriffs, as well as the current and former Michigan House Judiciary Committee Chairs. ](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001EroGmg3ZdvgeDJGeb1dxdUoD0lAnuSvXWIbIbWYZUnhNJ6yadILgOqUhJWmN8_HyCf70KfDO5eKe4SM1cRtiYQlvW3z2OaYzwrL6DywAc5V9lAp-Y9RF8L_StBTvIN3Oe1QP7ymq3kzv1Aza0RK2UXey6d35S24_0hmLBIiqyVOfP-Frkm1VXQ==&c=uTZHaWcI8q_7tYkaQ0q2cbl3ir6_GNTUwvd6hw278qjkUcc7Audhrw==&ch=vPgk_JLdikZk4tsrE9ILwTrfs1bHWhD8wkNQMgc32VYQ2_rNbMjYEA==)Together, those endorsements reflect broad confidence from leaders who have firsthand experience enforcing and shaping Michigan law.
Lloyd has made restoring law and order, supporting victims, and standing with law enforcement central to his campaign. The POAM endorsement further reinforces his record, readiness, and ability to win statewide.

## Trump Adds Iran Tariffs as Protests Grow
President Trump announced a [25% tariff on goods from any nation](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMGumzAQRb_G7BzZY0jCgkWqit3rpqq6RPPwkExlbDQegt7fV_QXur7S0T3n98f0gZw4P3_gSoMuZcp01ESqJBMLZt1lLZxQZuU58_OlKjiBg6t13vowReT0NbVNHBYioNDQ4G_Xe3AQHDSvAXpE37noeopAn317b2PbU7y1ffsJN2x4OGnO--C965y_wDV2eJ976CI6XIJpHUXWIpc_hbO-aElf5U1ymcvapOGlulUTHgZGA-NxHJe15nMzMFK2ezUwnlLnWCRFA6PKvm5227VaReFlsSXb07ZaFYycn3ZD0UxSLa4c7YFvsmWxmxSlqicLxT4e_lfnl2jCWGaOJnz_dpako_4k2RoZ4nZwSlyvN9O654qc_n3W_wr9HuBvAAAA__8_BZRs) doing business with Iran, targeting major trading partners like China, Brazil, Turkey, and Russia, to pressure Tehran over deadly nationwide protests. Trump told reporters aboard Air Force One that Iran called seeking to negotiate, with a meeting being set up, though he added that "we may have to act" before then as his administration weighs military strikes and [providing Elon Musk's Starlink](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2SozAQRk8DmSipxZ8DBZuQedMNqTY00GshUVJjxref8lxh8q--V-_9u493ZM9h_Ys7OVniGOjKnkQojZwwyJn2yB7TJDwFXjeRhCNoaJU2ythxRvbvsS5ntxAB2ZKc6drearAays01Hdq2naDvH6ZBWHSN2ELd0W3pph6xZPd508ZYY3SjTQXt3GA_3aCZUeNii1rTzBJT9T9ykI0W_44vStUU99K7TeTIhf1TwFDAcF1XtcSvx5k5UM6fTQHDET0LT7mAQdK5H-qROKyKfAxqP_NTPemtPrpq55w5hjK5-bjYe85tV9R63ZH9D1B-Venl4DsAAP__Rkp-TA) internet access to bypass the regime's blackout. The Iranian protests have so far resulted in over 550 deaths, more than 500 of them protestors and the rest security personnel, and over 10,600 people arrested since Dec. 28, while [photos captured](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkbGu2zAMRb9G3hRIVOz4DR66eHtdOxq0RVssZDGQlBj5-0LtJ3TicIFD3HN_fS_fyJHT8RNPmuouS6KrRKqV8sIZU33lUzhi3ipviY9Qa8YFDAzaWG3d4pHjZ7l3ftqJgFxHk30MozPgDHRh8l_rSj0C9SO58fHAFWgbvBtHWoehHzueGs1Y66w1vbE3GHyP4_YFvUeDu1N3Q56r5Ntv4VQD7fEjb8q3Tc4uTqHWZ1Huh4JZwZw-Tym1RQrmBlYwG6tgtqBgviRHr1tFBfMuUvEgXYJcRR-Z6c3p0DueHJmK5qSbAX39M6Qxee2pPCljpfjRhTBvoSU1ZHkdQecGkl17Qt_uKr6Bdsk6ypu8lkTtc5cn_7w4Ri7DQ93NcSLHv3Xqf23wnuBPAAAA__9Wn56B) grief-stricken families searching through rows of bodies in black bags outside Tehran's Kahrizak Forensic Medical Center. Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi [claimed the situation](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD3OpDAQRE9jMiP_DDAEDjYhm003RD12A70yNrKbQXP7FXuFLyvpSaV69ec1v4AipfU37Oh4yXPCq0ZkxjJTgcRn2TNFKJ7JJ1o35gKzUaaXSktt5wAUv_OjCW5BNGgbdHron1YZq0yzuTAqq999eA9gR2s6P4Zh0F4Fo562R9uQu9uU1lZr1Sndmj508PSj6QIoWKx4KAzEubR_MyXecInf_MHS-rw30W3MRxX2lzCTMNN1Xa1_19vi5sJMdxRmumXkUTJj5SrPKrmc-yEDAm-Sc4wyws0kFFg3v5H0EWivshKfwJSTPFPAIn1OXHIUZmqKC8dFMVLtB_FQ6w4U_6_iH135ceZfAAAA__8vVIuV) was "under total control" while Parliament Speaker Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf warned that "in the case of an attack on Iran, the occupied territories (Israel) as well as all U.S. bases and ships will be our legitimate target."
## GOP Senators Push Back on Powell Probe
Republican Sen. Thom Tillis said he will [block any Trump](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGu4yAQheGnwR0WjB0nKVxs4-5uu6WFYYhndwALT4Lu26-SV7j1kT4d_X--1i9HTPnx2yWcJZY1YzsZRbCuVF2WZ02F2FUv5DM9dpHqVjAwaWO1HdbgiL_XsQtzRAQcOpztdboNBgYD3T7DfQIb3QQGA0Y3xqud3O12iThs7jreO5rfmrF2sNZcjO1hChd383e4BGdcHNRoMJCU2v8tlGXHyN_lhbX3JXU87yLHqYZfChYFS2ut93nz71HB8qYVLMYqWCwoWCoez43Ju6xPzFr2krQQM536VdqppeiNi_-npT7TceqIQeeSKCOeOhbm0ig_9FEaMuujlg37XRJ3dQ5H-0DTVY3mkRzx56H8KOtrhv8BAAD__46Ajis) appointees to the Federal Reserve following revelations the Justice Department is investigating Jerome Powell for potential perjury charges over his congressional testimony about the Fed's $2.5 billion headquarters renovation. GOP Sen. Lisa Murkowski also expressed her opposition, calling the investigation "nothing more than an attempt at coercion" after speaking with Powell on Monday morning. The Republican opposition complicates replacing Powell, whose term as chair expires in May. The Senate Banking Committee has 13 Republicans and 11 Democrats, meaning [even one defection](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unDAQRp8GukH-AdZbUKTZ7qZNiQYYYG6MB9mTRbx9tHmF9J8-nXN-fY1fyJHT9hMPGnSVMdFVIqlSHjlj0j_5EI6YZ-U58barZhydcT0YC9aPC3K8x7ZehpXIka9psI8-eOO8cfU-GHw824n6JxnrwxxCsBgmmtxs2m5qu5qHz5ux1ltrOmMb1y8dhvnpugUNrr5qDS2skptv4aQ7rfGWN-VmlqOOw656lsr_qNyrcq-VE6aZmht3kc-icq-PUuVeDn7TDZucUCihSi5Q8Abd6YYLkwJCUTlBEqy0QJKDE1GBVWKUi9MGi3yD7plQC-CGnIrCKRfFCPbR-taFEJpdj1jnYTkvjpFL_6hasx3I8R-v_lfk9-D-BgAA__8I85NP) creates a stalemate. Trump is expected to interview BlackRock's Rick Rieder this week as the [fourth and final](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuwjAQQL8m2RzZ5yTA4KFLNrp2jIx9JlccG10OUv6-or_Q_ek96X2d57OnTOX66Vd0kupccN8yiiDPxL7Ig9dK2XMQCoWuiwj7GTSMShtl7Bw95dfct9ElREDbojOH8Wg1WA3t4iKaAHrUySDAkHBAM-oQzMkP2NvD0JJ727Qx1hg9aNPBGAd_DCcYotc-2abXGEkqd9-ViiyY8qs-kbtQ1za7ReS-NfajgamBad_3LtWfy2Ojgtv2ZhqYMNRS11cDk_BjvSsqgvwk3NUl-3DjGm6bYgo3xYQRWSWMKiyeWHHN2LKL951ypm08NL2-rp7yX17-9ezp4DcAAP__c02DkA) candidate for Fed chair, joining finalists former Federal Reserve Board Governor Kevin Warsh, National Economic Council Director Kevin Hassett, and Federal Reserve Board Governor Christopher Waller.
## List: World's Largest Proven Oil Reserves
Venezuela holds the [world's largest proven oil reserves](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb8GOqOxHQgpXGxDl223RLP2EObJYGRPsPK-_in5hdddXV1dHZ1_9_mOHHl__MWNnCxp3qmWSCKUZ864yzNviSNmL-x3fqwiGWcDZlCglbZzQI6v-dIGtxAZsi05fR1GC8aCaVeHA4xACwCMY_D9_xBut1HbISxI3pjQsnu_gdZWa-hBd2YIPY7-ZvqAgIttLkCBJeXuK_EuKy3xlU7KnU9bG90qcpTG_mnM1Jip1tqdXJ4YPR4sGLnIe9iYaU1VnbTT95MiFpU4qkyF8klF-bQdmElJUrLSuxeVlk-uKcfQmKnNLhyVY-QyXJsLPDbk-GGQX4k7nfkJAAD__3dphZs) at 303 billion barrels, accounting for about 17% of the global total and well ahead of Saudi Arabia's 267 billion barrels. Despite its vast reserves, Venezuela ranked just 21st in oil production in 2024 at about 960,000 barrels per day, down from its 1970s peak of 3.5 million barrels per day. Decades of mismanagement, underinvestment, and international sanctions have constrained the country's oil sector, with most reserves concentrated in the Orinoco Belt where deposits are predominantly heavy crude that's more expensive to produce. President Trump has stated that Venezuela's oil industry would be revived through the entry of American companies following the recent U.S. operation to capture President Nicolas Maduro. See how [Venezuela's oil reserves compare to the rest of the world](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb8GOqOxHQgpXGxDl223RLP2EObJYGRPsPK-_in5hdddXV1dHZ1_9_mOHHl__MWNnCxp3qmWSCKUZ864yzNviSNmL-x3fqwiGWcDZlCglbZzQI6v-dIGtxAZsi05fR1GC8aCaVeHA4xACwCMY_D9_xBut1HbISxI3pjQsnu_gdZWa-hBd2YIPY7-ZvqAgIttLkCBJeXuK_EuKy3xlU7KnU9bG90qcpTG_mnM1Jip1tqdXJ4YPR4sGLnIe9iYaU1VnbTT95MiFpU4qkyF8klF-bQdmElJUrLSuxeVlk-uKcfQmKnNLhyVY-QyXJsLPDbk-GGQX4k7nfkJAAD__3dphZs).

name: Andrew Beck
subject: Ramping up the Campaign
body:
Good morning,

With fewer than 300 days until the general election, the Beck for Congress campaign is ramping up its organization, events, and outreach. I am inviting you to join our team to help us succeed this fall. We are looking for volunteers to staff events, gather nomination signatures, knock on doors, and spread the word about our campaign.

I will be attending the following upcoming meetings:

\- Waukesha County Dems: Thursday, 1/15
\- Jefferson County Dems: Tuesday, 1/27 (Tentative)
\- Washington County Dems: Wednesday, 1/28
\- Francesca Hong Gathering: Saturday, 2/14, 12:00 PM – 2:00 PM at the HUB coffee house in West Bend

Additionally, I am seeking specific assistance in the following areas:

1\. Photography: A professional or amateur to assist with campaign headshots and event photos.
2\. Social Media: Someone to manage our digital presence and increase engagement.
3\. Website Maintenance: Managing updates for events, endorsements, and general oversight.
4\. Treasurer: Someone to take over financial reporting and management.
5\. Fundraising Coordination: An individual with the experience or drive to help reach our financial goals.

We plan to hold a weekly Zoom call to coordinate efforts and exchange ideas. This is a group effort, and we will win as a team.

Please reach out if you are interested in helping or if you know someone who might be a good fit.

Thanks,
Andy

**Andrew Beck**
Candidate for the US Congress
[andy.beck@beckforcongress.com](mailto:andy.beck@beckforcongress.com)
Phone: 262-399-5272

[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/beck-for-congress-1)

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

You're a 62-year-old who has put money away all your life.

You've done so to secure a comfortable retirement, on your own terms.

But you also want to pass your retirement savings balance to your loved ones.

This includes your 401(k)s... traditional IRAs... even your Roth IRAs.

Of course you want your hard-earned (and growing) money to last as long as it can, and — just as importantly — to get taxed as little as possible.

Better brace yourself.

The rules we've grown accustomed to are getting completely turned upside down by Congress.

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. name: Frank S. Wright - Corporal, U.S. Marine Corps (Ret.)
subject: I was sixteen when I lied to join the Marines
body:
I was wounded twice, but many never made it home
I still remember seeing the flag raised on Iwo Jima...

| | | [](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=8d036cf8daa44a3eaa75e8f451870312&_e=KmfH6Z68d0o6RX64xNedxcXjbGVE6xkHzVBvPozvaapLpjNkCYx2VvXX7YjNXdaZbikEE3sHQEquC8NPuMpNjFCcfefYgoI-FhtkFRQ_oWzysjYcTD8Ar6UScGMyEcThbkqvuLPQVfSYAsAee78hlS7cocO_kIM9czXNg5DS48MYdu54ZdQy8z0CfEFimJpERSk1EtBoN6QkMi8fCFiXyh-yrOwOTpGHssbTmZWU-PF3yZ38JKrj7q_WopUt8bQujmEwc0Lb_ZGCHdhZaPlDeje1fETQqV858HnHNfj-8lioDelZ6m34t44tOxDK-B5mOgIYkUiObdMgatJUcLM_MMwhU99v3-fh_JXtHo9rRzWSA17xccct7XHg9wMYIT5wXXak4ryVmGcRQT-2PQbXxU1vP2qLk7Lye9tR2hjtDXAZBy0iphvfMJMKibcH-XxKxpBKOrNOY1kYc30wYNgQnzjDRp_LiliFOtyYb-UKd8lXmPiC8jyZBFRmvjdyCXYrOdYaMr9e83EoFik2qZumhORrwf_T7Gv9UINujdY0UwY2RPAFEfQ3zW6PlVWOSmwD0GUXz_iRka5du3TA2plgjXbL_AfeiIWi1Dq2J0_JVy32TtUORyq2QThoFQ7EkEe0kY7brvJ5TxU4dIcFTNRz7Tcvg9FWgGoGaMpv6UqA5sE%3D)
---
Peter,
---
My name is **Corporal Frank S. Wright** , United States Marine Corps, retired. I'm a hundred years old now -- one of the last living Marine Raiders of World War II.In January 1942, just weeks after the attack on Pearl Harbor, I quit high school in Arkansas and walked into the enlistment office. I was sixteen -- too young, too skinny, and too light to qualify. The sergeant told me to come back when I was heavier.So I went home, ate all the bananas I could find, and stuffed five pounds' worth into my pockets before stepping on that scale again.I passed. I lied about my age. And I became a Marine.
---
[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=8d036cf8daa44a3eaa75e8f451870312&_e=KmfH6Z68d0o6RX64xNedxcXjbGVE6xkHzVBvPozvaapLpjNkCYx2VvXX7YjNXdaZbikEE3sHQEquC8NPuMpNjFCcfefYgoI-FhtkFRQ_oWzysjYcTD8Ar6UScGMyEcThbkqvuLPQVfSYAsAee78hlS7cocO_kIM9czXNg5DS48MYdu54ZdQy8z0CfEFimJpERSk1EtBoN6QkMi8fCFiXyh-yrOwOTpGHssbTmZWU-PE7mExsFRupV5EuWkCNc1r9ugfLttJLubWAsdlnhDofeSTGjBLO_n5spWmTq2oQQgeV2yQRcjwwHieWAZ65TxEUQrB0hA3tTc6TdjNBP6NwoxNV-r3U_XDDSwRNv80DQqwvzTXSpNcyvyfplti35ghokaojdOCwqxTeGrAeQvZPCReAHynlYUVK9ySc5SUWcNyjsEdJ39aok4FcYoES-0U0BIBs-Kdlph-VUzW96runtjtzo069fxfKkK1AZUtCypMZy1eTK6_60YusqW4QCyr_uyGc86vra-nbydQBEuBi7VMJ7kwJxr6PPnltHkSWo0V21vAqStcRFQ3PrNf_98FT_-XcmCya489onOQqlU-OSi3IWgAc27uJHg4hoMUUmMMBIxGX3V6cZwujojhVgYYZBivxphYfoUP7J5wbjaogOncYmh1hcjFUSSRemRBRhPQ%3D)
---
After boot camp, I volunteered to join the **4th Marine Raiders** , America's first special operations unit.They asked me why I wanted to join. I said, _" Because I want to fight."_Our commanding officer was **James Roosevelt** , the President's son -- a good man, the kind who never gave an order he wouldn't do himself. We were trained to land first, fight behind enemy lines, and take the beaches nobody else could reach.From **Guadalcanal** to **New Georgia** , from the jungles of the Solomons to the black sand of **Iwo Jima** , we fought to free the Pacific.On **Guam** , I was stabbed in the stomach during hand-to-hand combat. On **Iwo Jima** , I was hit by machine-gun fire and knocked unconscious. Both times, my men thought I was gone. Somehow, I wasn't.When I came to, I saw the flag rising on Mount Suribachi. Every ship in the harbor sounded its horn. I had tears in my eyes then, and I still do when I think about it.That flag meant freedom still lived.
---
[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=8d036cf8daa44a3eaa75e8f451870312&_e=KmfH6Z68d0o6RX64xNedxcXjbGVE6xkHzVBvPozvaapLpjNkCYx2VvXX7YjNXdaZbikEE3sHQEquC8NPuMpNjFCcfefYgoI-FhtkFRQ_oWzysjYcTD8Ar6UScGMyEcThbkqvuLPQVfSYAsAee78hlS7cocO_kIM9czXNg5DS48MYdu54ZdQy8z0CfEFimJpERSk1EtBoN6QkMi8fCFiXyh-yrOwOTpGHssbTmZWU-PG7Jx6jNyOF_Mxn6RToRvke-5sn6lQyS40ZRwglICwJgBO1AimoBD-Rxb8P0KMMYM8SD2sOm1scrZUYbMfCDTqi3dSiHag3l0hVh7BjyY50FCaFc9GvCA8jRz2kETPTbG1jfcRGEyGs5R47wcfHwY234jfsnatZWeGel30LwUn7zx6_j407-xemhiLS4WjStK3Tc4MM1HkbK_Vo5iEFkfleC-VlGeZzN0yiJJqFbKdTWtJdlKhKFFBpTk5dZ9ZgkEyG1mt7d_MPgekrRAJdH0y8ZMbOif3qx_0LOOmINf5tU5TmXg8pQWxM0vDKKYzQSw4ajqQx8_FI3zrGWiuwXcQOlmYwnt0tajYJND0rvnvJoqwhWtG2XBn7eYNE6KAYxiSUaeUMatD9P5-JlxV0YBJb0EHnIfzI6SvOfQfS1XAMSmkKJYIp2h5h1KCjrErWDrg%3D)
---
There were dark days too...On Guadalcanal, I caught malaria and ended up in a field hospital -- but when my unit was preparing to move out, I couldn't stand being left behind.I slipped out and rejoined them. I'll now admit, I was always a little rebellious. When the war ended, I became a drill instructor, helping shape the next generation of Marines. I was in my twenties, carrying wounds inside and out.For more than a decade, I didn't share my stories. I kept them locked away, like many of my brothers did. Over the years, I began to open up and share my story with friends, family, and others who wanted to know about the realities of the battlefield at the Pacific Front.Now, more than ever, the **American Veterans Center** has given me the opportunity to share them -- on the stage at the **Annual Conference** , and by capturing them on film for future generations. Not just my story, but those of the men who never came home, and those who are no longer here to tell theirs.

clean_body: I was wounded twice, but many never made it home I still remember seeing the flag raised on Iwo Jima... | | | Peter, My name is Corporal Frank S. Wright , United States Marine Corps, retired. I'm a hundred years old now -- one of the last living Marine Raiders of World War II.In January 1942, just weeks after the attack on Pearl Harbor, I quit high school in Arkansas and walked into the enlistment office. I was sixteen -- too young, too skinny, and too light to qualify. The sergeant told me to come back when I was heavier.So I went home, ate all the bananas I could find, and stuffed five pounds' worth into my pockets before stepping on that scale again.I passed. I lied about my age. And I became a Marine. After boot camp, I volunteered to join the 4th Marine Raiders , America's first special operations unit.They asked me why I wanted to join. I said, " Because I want to fight."Our commanding officer was James Roosevelt , the President's son -- a good man, the kind who never gave an order he wouldn't do himself. We were trained to land first, fight behind enemy lines, and take the beaches nobody else could reach.From Guadalcanal to New Georgia , from the jungles of the Solomons to the black sand of Iwo Jima , we fought to free the Pacific.On Guam , I was stabbed in the stomach during hand-to-hand combat. On Iwo Jima , I was hit by machine-gun fire and knocked unconscious. Both times, my men thought I was gone. Somehow, I wasn't.When I came to, I saw the flag rising on Mount Suribachi. Every ship in the harbor sounded its horn. I had tears in my eyes then, and I still do when I think about it.That flag meant freedom still lived. There were dark days too...On Guadalcanal, I caught malaria and ended up in a field hospital -- but when my unit was preparing to move out, I couldn't stand being left behind.I slipped out and rejoined them. I'll now admit, I was always a little rebellious. When the war ended, I became a drill instructor, helping shape the next generation of Marines. I was in my twenties, carrying wounds inside and out.For more than a decade, I didn't share my stories. I kept them locked away, like many of my brothers did. Over the years, I began to open up and share my story with friends, family, and others who wanted to know about the realities of the battlefield at the Pacific Front.Now, more than ever, the American Veterans Center has given me the opportunity to share them -- on the stage at the Annual Conference , and by capturing them on film for future generations. Hey everybody, it’s Mark.
We all remember what happened five years ago this month. Donald Trump sent a mob to the Capitol to steal an election.

Now he’s back, five years later, and it’s the same scheme. His Secretary of Defense, Pete Hegseth, is trying to silence me as we speak. He thinks he can make an example out of me, and intimidate others into staying quiet.

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

# Vaccine Choice is on the 2026 GOP Primary Ballot
---
| |
---
| Thanks to the work of grassroots activists within several county Republican parties across the state, the Republican Party of Texas approved a **Primary Ballot Proposition that calls attention to the widespread vaccine discrimination many patients face.** Think of this as a straw poll, wherein the Texas GOP is getting input from its voters about issues that matter the most. The outcome of this vote will help shape both the **Republican Party platform and its priorities** for the 90th Legislative Session. **Proposition Three reads:** “Texas should prohibit denial of healthcare or any medical service based solely on the patient’s vaccination status.” While Team TFVC has made **great strides** in recent sessions to chip away at vaccine discrimination, first with HB 44 in 2023 - which prohibits this type of unethical practice for patients on state-funded health insurance plans - and then HB 4076 in 2025 - which prohibits vaccination-based discrimination for organ transplant patients. Pushing for a **policy that protects _all Texans_** would be a huge victory! **Early Voting** for the 2026 Primary runs from Tuesday, February 17 through Friday, February 27. **Election Day** is Tuesday, March 3! Mexico City is my home. clean_body: Today a child is waiting to be found—will you answer the call? There are no ICU beds left. That's what we're changing, right now. | | | Friend, Mexico City is my home. It's where I was born, where I learned to believe in God's purpose, and where I first saw the kind of poverty and pain that can break your heart.When I speak with our partners there, the stories of children in need make my heart ache.You may know me as the producer of the blockbuster film Sound of Freedom. But what you may not know is that the film became the foundation for a massive movement, the Sound of Freedom Foundation. A humanitarian organization that rescues children from sex trafficking, supports their recovery, and helps stop exploitation before it begins. In hospitals across Mexico city, vulnerable children, including those rescued from trafficking and abuse, are now fighting to survive. But there aren't enough ICU beds to care for them.Some lie on stretchers or floors, waiting for a chance at healing that may never come.That's why I've set a goal: I want to raise $20,000 to deliver $200,000 worth of ICU beds to hospitals and medical centers that serve God's children in Mexico City. These beds are lifelines. They are where a fragile heartbeat stabilizes, where a child's breathing grows stronger, where healing happens. Every $1 you give becomes $10 of real medical value.How?Because through the Sound of Freedom Foundation's partnerships with trusted humanitarian distributors, we're able to secure bulk discounts on high-need medical equipment. That means every dollar raised helps unlock $10 worth of ICU beds, monitors, and lifesaving hospital supplies. enough to care for children who are sick, weak, and desperately in need of help.$25 -> provides $250 worth of ICU equipment and supplies. $50 -> provides $500 toward children's ICU beds. $100 -> provides $1,000 in needed ICU supplies. $250 or more -> helps equip an entire hospital ward for rescued children. - When these beds arrive, they will go straight into hospitals that have been praying for help, to doctors who refuse to give up, and nurses who comfort frightened children through the night.And the impact doesn't end there. Because when desperate families can access medical care for their children, they no longer face the unthinkable choice of selling a son or daughter just to survive.In communities where poverty and sickness make children vulnerable to traffickers, a single hospital bed can mean the difference between a child staying with their loving family or being trafficked and abused. This is what we can change together.We have the plan. We have the partners. But this mission can't launch without you.Friend, the next few days will decide how many children we can help, how many will have a bed instead of the floor, and hope instead of fear. If we reach our goal, those hospital rooms will be transformed. The caregivers will have the tools they need. And the children will finally be able to rest, to heal, and to live, safe from the predators who prey on desperation.If we fall short, vulnerable children will not receive the medical care they need and their families may be forced into the kind of impossible decisions that result in more children being trafficked and exploited for profit. For God's children, Eduardo Verastegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For the Sound of Freedom Foundation 6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074

Hi — I’m Imani Ford, Kevin’s wife, and I wanted to personally share how proud I am of Kevin and the way he’s taken on this campaign with courage, humility, and purpose.[**He truly believes in service, in community, and in leaving something better for all of our children than what we inherited.**](https://v8k6.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6966499d96027a6114a89ff4&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fimaniford&w=621a637cd079466c7b27a083&c=b_69652c157ab6ac20022415e1&l=en-US&s=3cfDRIDpcTfat6nkjqgWBdsJaow%3D) I won’t sugarcoat it—this journey hasn’t been easy. Campaigns take time, energy, and sacrifice, and that doesn’t just fall on the candidate. It touches the whole family. There are late nights, long days, and moments when we miss him because he’s out knocking doors or listening to neighbors who need to be heard. K3, John, and I feel that sacrifice deeply—but we are all-in behind him because we believe in his heart and his calling.
---
That’s why I’m reaching out now, neighbor to neighbor.
[**Our fundraising deadline is TOMORROW, and to reach our goal Kevin needs 60 families across Prince George’s County and Maryland to step up with a $250 donation.** ](https://v8k6.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6966499d96027a6114a89ff4&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fimaniford&w=621a637cd079466c7b27a083&c=b_69652c157ab6ac20022415e1&l=en-US&s=3cfDRIDpcTfat6nkjqgWBdsJaow%3D)When you break it down, _**this is truly doable**_ —and I believe our village can make it happen.[**If you’re able to give $250 by Wednesday, I’m asking you to do so. If that amount isn’t possible right now, please give whatever you can.**](https://v8k6.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6966499d96027a6114a89ff4&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fimaniford&w=621a637cd079466c7b27a083&c=b_69652c157ab6ac20022415e1&l=en-US&s=3cfDRIDpcTfat6nkjqgWBdsJaow%3D)_**Every single contribution matters.**_ What’s most important is showing up and participating in this moment.And if giving financially isn’t an option, **we also need** **volunteers**. This campaign runs on people power, and your time and energy make a real difference. If you—or someone you know—can help, please sign up here:
👉 [**kfordjr.com/volunteer**](https://v8k6.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6966499d96027a6114a89ff4&u=https%3A%2F%2Fkfordjr.com%2Fvolunteer&w=621a637cd079466c7b27a083&c=b_69652c157ab6ac20022415e1&l=en-US&s=oggLeg64D56u8NKnFlX7dIwtL64%3D) Whether you support us through a donation, volunteering, sharing this message, or keeping our family in your prayers, please know how much it means to me. This is bigger than a campaign—it’s about standing together when it counts.Thank you for reading and standing with Kevin!With love and gratitude,**Imani**
