# **ICE agent involved in shooting unlikely to face charges, DOJ declines civil rights probe**
The ICE agent who fatally shot protester Renee Nicole Good in Minneapolis **[is unlikely to face criminal charges,](https://substack.com/redirect/8199c826-64c3-4d4b-adaa-91fd15c4885a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with the Justice Department not expected to open a civil rights probe into the deadly ordeal, according to the New York Times citing sources familiar with the investigation, though the decision could change as FBI investigators analyze agent Jonathan Ross's conduct and key physical evidence including the handgun involved.
* **Trump administration labels Good "domestic terrorist," claims self-defense:** The Trump administration, including Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem, quickly branded Good a "domestic terrorist" and argued the ICE agent only fired the fatal shots in self-defense after the alleged agitator struck him with her vehicle, while federal investigators are zeroing in on Good's links to anti-ICE activist groups and examining actions of activists who took part in neighborhood watch activities leading up to her death.
* **Good was trained anti-ICE "warrior" affiliated with radical groups:** Friends claimed Good was an anti-ICE "warrior" drawn into activism through her six-year-old son's charter school and its local "ICE Watch" group, with neighbors saying she regularly attended meetings and received "thorough training," while the group recently aligned with more radical organizations including Twin Cities Ungovernables and shared a manual on fighting police to free arrested comrades, comparing each "de-arrest" to a "micro-intifada."

* * *
# **Supreme Court hears transgender athlete cases Tuesday**
The Supreme Court **[will hear oral arguments Tuesday in two cases](https://substack.com/redirect/2893f47e-845e-484d-a3a8-73ab5e62f0eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** --Little v. Hecox and West Virginia v. B.P.J.--that could determine whether states can ban transgender athletes who identify as women from competing on girls' and women's sports teams, examining whether Idaho and West Virginia laws prohibiting such participation violate Title IX and the Constitution's equal protection clause.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2893f47e-845e-484d-a3a8-73ab5e62f0eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Lower courts struck down state bans, Republicans appeal:** Lower courts struck down the bans as unconstitutional violations of Title IX and equal protection, prompting the two Republican-led states to appeal to the Supreme Court, with West Virginia Attorney General JB McCuskey telling Fox News the issue is "about Title IX, equal protection, common sense, and protecting women in both academia and on the athletic field."
* **Trump administration backs states, ACLU represents transgender athletes:** The Trump administration is supporting the states, asserting that Title IX and equal protection permit sex-based distinctions in athletics, while the American Civil Liberties Union represents the transgender plaintiffs and argues the laws "unlawfully discriminate against people who identify as women," with the debate garnering enormous attention evidenced by dozens of amicus briefs and even a Washington Post editorial supporting the states' position.
* **Ruling could have far-reaching policy implications:** Observers say a ruling for the plaintiffs could limit state power to adopt similar bans and broaden interpretations of federal nondiscrimination protections, while a decision for the states could uphold the bans and influence other transgender policy disputes such as bathroom policies and sex designation on documents like passports and driver's licenses, with the Supreme Court expected to decide the cases by early summer.

# **Mamdani fires back at DHS after NYC Council employee detained at immigration appointment**
The Department of Homeland Security detained Rafael Andres Rubio Bohorquez, 53, a New York City Council employee working as a data analyst, during an immigration appointment Monday in Nassau County, with DHS saying the migrant overstayed a 2017 tourist visa and was arrested in an assault case, **[prompting Mayor Zohran Mamdani to call it](https://substack.com/redirect/e3a0454a-42ad-4b2a-98df-427938822e60?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** "an assault on our democracy, on our city, and our values" and demand his immediate release.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a03e0118-aff1-4027-af8d-943f8edbb38b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **NYC officials claim employee authorized until October 2026:** NYC Council Speaker Julie Menin held a press conference demanding the employee's release, claiming he "had been cleared to remain in the U.S. until October 2026" and "was doing everything right" by going to court when asked, stating "DHS confirmed that this employee had gone in for a routine court appointment and was nevertheless detained" with "no other basis for his detainment."
* **DHS dismisses complaints, says detention justified:** DHS spokeswoman Tricia McLaughlin dismissed the complaints, saying "He had no legal right to be in the United States" and maintaining the man is not authorized to work in the U.S., adding "Under Secretary Noem, criminal illegal aliens are not welcome in the United States. If you come to our country illegally and break our law, we will find you, and we will arrest you."

Patriot,

Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn't a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal -- the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God's grace. **

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**" God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." **_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.

Charlie's hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

In the months since Charlie's assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA's message among young Americans...

...and it's not just the conservative message as a whole -- _**it 's the message of FAITH! **_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie's call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it 's happening. _

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we're witnessing is not just growth --**it 's revival. **

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America 's faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up. **

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _" We're not backing down." _

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie's most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie 's faith. _**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

His book, Stop, in the Name of God is the fruit of that conviction. When you read it, you will hear Charlie's voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family. Charlie's hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive... A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us. I believe you will find this book inspiring. Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life. In the months since Charlie's assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA's message among young Americans... ...and it's not just the conservative message as a whole -- it 's the message of FAITH! In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie's call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God. Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. And it 's happening. After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country. What we're witnessing is not just growth --it 's revival. At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old. We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families. We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message. You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie. But America 's faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up. All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, " We're not backing down." This is what Charlie prayed for. I see this book as one of Charlie's most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too. None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, so will the legacy of Charlie 's faith. Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God. I'll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible. Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie's mission and supporting his legacy. For Charlie, Justin Streiff Chief Operating Officer Turning Point USA P.S. When you read Stop, in the Name of God, you will discover what Charlie found in the Sabbath: a holy rest that steadies the heart, renews the soul, and gives strength for the road ahead. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

body:
RuthsListFL.org [RuthsListFL.org]
Peter,
Today is Day 1 of Florida’s Legislative Session– and we’re sharing our 2026 Watchlist to help supporters like you stay vigilant and make an impact on the policies our state adopts this year.
Continue Receiving 2026 Watchlist Updates [https://secure.ngpvan.com/6KbHY7iYOEKu7m3OL7wc4g2]
First, here are the anti-reproductive freedom bills that have been filed this Session:
❌HB 663/SB 1374 Civil Remedies Pertaining to Abortions would allow a pregnant woman’s family members to sue anyone who tries to provide her with abortion care– both during and up to 2 years after her pregnancy. This would not only give husbands, parents, and siblings the opportunity to block patients from having abortions, but it would also create a $100,000 payout for winners of civil suits against providers.
This is a deeply cruel proposal that would put a bounty on the heads of doctors, nurses, pharmacists, and even family members who are trying to help loved ones receive care. Please help us raise awareness and contact your state representatives and urge them to oppose HB 663/SB 1374. [https://dos.fl.gov/elections/contacts/elected-officials/]
❌ SB 164/HB 289 Civil Liability for the Wrongful Death of an Unborn Child would allow either parent to sue medical providers for the loss or termination of a pregnancy. If passed, this law would jeopardize millions of women’s access to fertility and emergency care services by putting lawyers in charge of the decisions that doctors should make when caring for a pregnant patient.
We know that Floridians have the power to stop this bill, because we’ve done it before. This is Senator Grall’s third year in a row as a sponsor for this bill [https://www.tallahassee.com/story/news/local/state/2025/11/04/florida-senate-committee-oks-fetal-personhood-bill-abortion-erin-grall-law/87083156007/] , but each year it is too extreme, even for the Republican supermajority.
TAKE ACTION: Contact your representatives and tell them to vote NO on SB 164/HB 289 [https://www.weareplannedparenthoodaction.org/a/sb164-hb289-action]
❌SB 166/HB 173 Parental Rights would prohibit physicians from providing contraception and STI testing to minors without parental consent. Requiring parental consent for sexual and reproductive healthcare for all minors, regardless of their circumstances, is so extreme that in 2025, this policy was opposed by both Democrats and Republicans. Now, we must continue fighting for minors’ safety and access to care.
TAKE ACTION: Contact your representatives and tell them to vote NO on SB 166/HB 173 [https://www.weareplannedparenthoodaction.org/a/sb-166-hb-173-action]
❌SB 1090/HB 1071 Education was also proposed (and failed) in 2025. Read more about this proposed change to Florida’s sexual/reproductive healthcare education curriculum here: Will Florida require schools to show fetal development video? [https://www.tampabay.com/news/education/2026/01/06/will-florida-require-schools-show-fetal-development-video/] (Tampa Bay Times)
Next up, here are bills supporting women’s rights and reproductive healthcare access that are sponsored by our pro-choice champions in the State Legislature that will need your support. Please follow and sign-up to receive updates from the offices of these Ruth’s List alumnae to learn how to support each piece of legislation.
✅HB 6001/SB 242 Pregnancy Support and Wellness Services , sponsored by Representative Kelly Skidmore and Senator Kristen Arrington. Read more here: Kelly Skidmore files bill to end state funding for anti-abortion pregnancy centers [https://floridapolitics.com/archives/756435-kelly-skidmore-files-bill-to-end-state-funding-for-anti-abortion-pregnancy-centers/] .
✅SB 414/HB 361 Use of Campaign Funds for Campaign-related Child Care Expenses , sponsored by Senator LaVon Bracy Davis and Representative Kelly Skidmore. Read more here: LaVon Bracy Davis, Kelly Skidmore refile bills to let campaign funds cover child care costs [https://floridapolitics.com/archives/764633-lavon-bracy-davis-kelly-skidmore-refile-bills-to-let-campaign-funds-cover-child-care-costs/] .
✅SCR 82 Equal Rights for Men and Women , a resolution by Senate Democratic Leader Lori Berman.
✅SB 386/HB 1351 Presumptive Medicaid Eligibility for Pregnant Women, sponsored by Senate Democratic Leader-Designate Tracie Davis.
✅SB 172/HB 59 Pregnant Women in Custody , sponsored by Representative Diane Hart and co-introduced by Representative Debra Tendrich
✅HB 137 Coverage for Mammograms and Supplemental Breast Cancer Screenings, sponsored by Representative Diane Hart
✅HB 161/SB 190 Impact of Perimenopause and Menopause on Women's Health, sponsored by Representative Yvonne Hinson, co-introduced by Representative Marie Woodson, with Senate sponsors Barbara Sharieff, Rosalind Osgood, and Leader-Designate Tracie Davis.
✅HB 825/SB 220 Paid Parental Leave, sponsored by Representative Rita Harris and House Democratic Leader Fentrice Driskell, and co-introduced in the Senate by Kristen Arrington.
✅HB 331 Reproductive Health and Instructional Materials , by Representative Diane Hart
✅SB 514/HB 515 Doula Support for Healthy Births Pilot Program , sponsored by Senator Rosalind Osgood.
Even under the Republican supermajority, Democratic members and advocates have succeeded in both passing good policies and blocking bad ones. The majority of anti-choice bills in the Legislature this year have been filed before and have failed.
Stopping further legal restrictions on abortion care, contraception, and our autonomy is important work– and we must continue raising our voices and holding lawmakers’ feet to the fire when they try to take away our rights.
If you want to continue receiving updates on the 2026 Florida Legislative Session and reproductive healthcare policies in our state, click here stay subscribed to future editions of our 2026 Watchlist . [https://secure.ngpvan.com/6KbHY7iYOEKu7m3OL7wc4g2]
-Ruth’s List HQ

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123224918/594763273/-1372980179?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk5675-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNTczYjNkNy04OGYwLWYwMTEtODE5NC0wMDBkM2ExMWY5MDMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=82_fINTAkjIIT0HPv9MSNxto6jwx3BAYUswKpqxi1mM=)
Hey there, it’s Josh Shapiro. I’m at a loss for words. I am absolutely blown away by the support folks have shown my campaign since I announced that I’m running for reelection to continue serving as Pennsylvania’s Governor.
**We’re already off to an amazing start, and I truly could not do it without you. So before I say anything else, from the bottom of my heart:_thank you. _**
I’m ready to win this race and continue fighting for the best possible future for Pennsylvanians – a future where we can put our differences aside and find common ground on the issues that matter most. I know so many of you believe in that vision too, and it means the world to know I have you by my side.

That means this is our last chance to raise the resources we need to redraw fair maps, defend Virginia, and push back against extremist Republicans who are trying to rig the system and lock in power. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately. Across the country, Trump and his MAGA allies are moving fast to entrench themselves through gerrymandering and rushed special sessions. They’re betting that we won’t be ready — or funded — to fight back. We cannot let that happen here in the crucial swing state of Virginia. What we raise in the next day will determine whether Virginia stands up for fair representation and helps pave the way to a Blue House in 2026 — or whether extremists gain more ground. Photo by [CDC](https://substack.com/redirect/266b43c7-27c9-40a9-9c05-d76fd03d6e2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on [Unsplash](https://substack.com/redirect/b07ec923-dceb-4ce8-80b5-21043eeef85a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Mississippi's HB 2 is an education "omnibus," and that's both its strength and its risk. It bundles a lot of policy in one vehicle--some of it overdue, some of it ripe for political gamesmanship. But strip away the Christmas-tree packaging and the heart of the bill is clear: it moves power away from the system and back to families. In a state where too many parents feel trapped by ZIP code and bureaucracy, that's the right direction.
At the center is the Mississippi Education Freedom Program and its Magnolia Student Accounts. MSAs are simple in concept: the state deposits education dollars into an account, and parents use that money for real educational needs--tuition, fees, tutoring, curriculum, testing, transportation, and certain learning devices. It even draws a common-sense line in the sand by excluding entertainment tech like televisions, video-game consoles, and VR products. That's not "defunding" public education; it's acknowledging that education is about children, not institutions.
The bill also tries to avoid the biggest trap in school choice: letting the government "buy" private education and then slowly regulate it into a public-school clone. HB 2 explicitly says state agencies can't regulate participating schools' curriculum, teaching methods, admissions, discipline, governance, or daily operations. It does not force Mississippi statewide assessments, and it bars using the program as a backdoor to public-school accountability ratings. Instead, parents choose from approved assessments, results go to the fund manager, and the state publishes a program-level report with no student-identifying information. That's the kind of accountability adults should want--transparent outcomes without bureaucratic control.
HB 2's funding design is also more thoughtful than critics will admit. Students in the main category (participating school/postsecondary) receive an amount tied to the state's student base funding. Meanwhile, students in "nonparticipating schools" are capped at $2,000 per student (and $4,000 per household), and homeschool families are capped at $1,000 per family--small-dollar flexibility rather than a blank check. Unused funds can carry forward, and remaining funds after graduation can be used at participating postsecondary institutions, with eventual reversion rules to prevent permanent stockpiling.
Participation is phased--12,500 students in 2027-28, 15,000 the next year, 17,500, then 20,000--then expands only after the cap is hit and a waitlist forms. The bill prioritizes lower-income families using area median income tiers before any lottery is even allowed. That's a direct answer to the usual charge that "choice is only for the wealthy."
Finally, HB 2 reinforces choice beyond MSAs: it creates a pathway for student portability scholarships tied to transfers when funding disputes arise, establishes a "Tim Tebow Act" for homeschoolers to participate in public-school extracurriculars, and expands charter authorization language to allow charters in any district (subject to conditions).
Legislators should pass the school-freedom core--and keep it clean. Don't let side deals, new bureaucracies, or unrelated provisions poison what could be one of Mississippi's most meaningful pro-parent reforms in a generation.

name: Mark Kelly
subject: Do not be afraid. Do not be silent. Speak out.
body:
We all remember what happened five years ago this month.
Hey Peter, it's Mark.
We all remember what happened five years ago last week. Donald Trump sent a mob to the Capitol to steal an election.
He had just lost an election, fair and square, and he didn’t like the result. So he decided he was going to try to silence the voices of 81 million people.
It was one of the darkest days in the history of our country, but we made it through.
Now he’s back, five years later, and it’s the same scheme. His Secretary of Defense, Pete Hegseth, is trying to silence me as we speak. He thinks he can make an example out of me, and intimidate others into staying quiet.
But here’s the thing: Americans really like freedom of speech. You sign an oath to defend it when you join the military. Trying to silence people into compliance is just about the most un-American thing you can do. Period.
There is nothing Trump or Hegseth or anybody in that administration can do to shut me up. I am going to keep fighting for our people, our democracy, and our Constitution.
We’re not going to let him win. Not a chance. So, five years on from January 6th, I want you to take this to heart: **Do not be afraid. Do not be silent. Speak out.**
We’re going to get through this the same way we did back then: together.
**[Please, split a grassroots donation between Wes Moore and me to help support our fight against Trump. This is our toughest yet, and I need a huge team behind me.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260113-1.X_DJLk&refcode=em-20260113-1&t=1&akid=1206%2E1086043%2E8p5NWI)**

Thank you.
Mark

Celebrating Sanctity of Life Month as the Battle for Human Life Continues

We pray for moms facing a terrifying decision because of an unplanned pregnancy. We pray for the 14-year-old who has believed the
lie that she is not good enough, living the truth of her biological sex. We pray for individuals suffering the pain of a
potentially terminal health battle. May God hold each one, precious as they are, giving them strength, courage, and a revelation
of their value in His sight.

This week, we reflect on the history of Sanctity of Life Month and what it means today. Where are the battlelines for life drawn
and what are we being called to do? The lives of the innocent are at stake.

clean_body: Our guest on the podcast this week shares inspiring information on overcoming hormone havoc and restoring health. Plus, on the blog, we reflect on Sanctity of Life Month and what it means today. If you are having trouble viewing this email click here to view in your browser. [] [] [] January 13, 2026 • Newsletter Help for Hormone Havoc: Dr. Terri DeNeui Moms for America Weekly Podcast [] [] Moms for America Weekly Podcast [] Women of all ages can feel better. That's what Dr. Terri DeNeui is here to share with us. A nationally recognized speaker, author, and board-certified nurse practitioner, she holds advanced certifications and is pioneering an innovative approach to women's health. In 2008, she founded what is now EVEXIAS Medical Centers. She is also the author of Hormone Havoc: Dispelling the Myths & Misconceptions about Hormones in Women & Men (2023). Dr. Terri joined the podcast to discuss menopause challenges, hormone replacement therapy, good nutrition, and cycles of sleep and rest. Join us to be inspired for a fresh and healthy start to 2026! Like, subscribe and share. View the Podcast [] Listen to the Podcast [] Listen to the Podcast on Spotify [] Moms for America Weekly Blog [] [] Celebrating Sanctity of Life Month as the Battle for Human Life Continues We pray for moms facing a terrifying decision because of an unplanned pregnancy. We pray for the 14-year-old who has believed the lie that she is not good enough, living the truth of her biological sex. We pray for individuals suffering the pain of a potentially terminal health battle. May God hold each one, precious as they are, giving them strength, courage, and a revelation of their value in His sight. This week, we reflect on the history of Sanctity of Life Month and what it means today. Where are the battlelines for life drawn and what are we being called to do? NYT: Trump Regrets Not Seizing Voting Machines After 2020 Election [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=011326_1&amount=25]
No sugar-coating this, Team. President Trump said during a recent interview with The New York Times that he regretted not ordering the National Guard to seize voting machines in swing states after his loss in the 2020 election. In his own words:
“ Well, I should have. I don’t know that they [the National Guard] are sophisticated enough. You know, they’re good warriors. I’m not sure that they’re sophisticated enough in the ways of crooked Democrats, and the way they cheat, to figure that out. ”
Let's review the facts. Alleged mail-in ballot fraud was rigorously investigated, using millions of taxpayer dollars, resulting in few actual court cases -- most notably a man in Pennsylvania who returned his deceased mother's ballot for Donald Trump . Lies were repeatedly spread against voting machine manufacturer Dominion Voting Systems, resulting in $78 million in damages settled in a defamation case brought by Dominion against Fox News. Despite years of effort by hysterical MAGA partisans, no valid proof of any misdeeds relating to the 2020 election has been brought to light.
This is a big red warning sign for our elections coming up and our fight for voting rights in general. If the sitting president still can't accept defeat years later after winning another election and returning to power, what makes us think he'll accept election losses by his party in November?

They weren't, but MAGA sees her as a martyr for their cause and want her released.

subject: We wanted you to be the first to know:
body:
---
| [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-january-2026?amount=7&refcode=em_20260113_5768_fr&refcode2=5768_22930333_eIUrd7&akid=5768%2E22930333%2EeIUrd7)
---
Derek,
My name is Lorenza Ramirez, and I’m the National Organizing Director at the DNC. And today, I’m going to be very direct with you: Democrats have lost major ground to MAGA with young people. Unless we act now, we’ll be at a disadvantage for decades.
It’s my job to make sure that Democrats are reaching as many voters as we can, in communities all over the country.
I’m the first in my family to go to college, and it shaped how I see this work: Access matters. Winning back young voters won’t happen by accident. It will require intentional investment and a willingness to build new organizing programs that make getting involved in politics more accessible for young people who have felt left out.
So the DNC is taking charge. Through a first-of-its-kind partisan registration push, which we’re calling When We Count, we’ll register hundreds of thousands of new Democrats this year and train the next generation of organizers to do it. Take a look:
**_DNC Announces Brand New Voter Registration Program in Preparation for the 2026 Midterms_**
In a second, I’m going to ask you to make your [**first contribution of 2026**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-january-2026?amount=7&refcode=em_20260113_5768_fr&refcode2=5768_22930333_eIUrd7&akid=5768%2E22930333%2EeIUrd7) to help fund this work, but first let me explain why this is so important:
Democrats have lost ground because in the last few years, we’ve largely approached voter registration as a nonpartisan initiative. All the while, MAGA has built a hyper-partisan voter registration machine.
That ends now. The DNC is taking the lead in solving this problem and doing what it takes to reverse these registration trends in flippable congressional districts across the country.
If we’re successful, this might just help us flip Congress in November, Derek. We could win critical races, from your local school board all the way up to the Senate. The electoral consequences could be **_massive_** , but this program won’t be cheap. And the scale of our investment depends directly on grassroots support.
That’s why I’m asking you to chip in $7 today.
$7 to help us register thousands of new voters.
$7 to ensure Democrats make inroads in every community this year.
$7 to support work like this election cycle after election cycle — so we can take back Congress, and ultimately, the White House.
[**If initiatives like these are important to you, we hope you’ll consider pitching in a few dollars to help fund the work we’re doing:**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-january-2026?amount=7&refcode=em_20260113_5768_fr&refcode2=5768_22930333_eIUrd7&akid=5768%2E22930333%2EeIUrd7)

| | | When Tim Wu and I ran for office as innocents 11 years ago, we were determined to make antitrust part of our platform. We even held an event for ripping up monopolist cable bills. But it was hard to break through--while people understood that corporate power was crushing them, the press didn't really. The combination of Covid, AI-pricing games, junk fee slop, Trump corruption of the media and the Trump-big tech nexus--and of course the incredible leadership of Lina Khan at the FTC--means that today, antitrust is mainstream politics. In the last congressional cycle, the antimonopoly fever really hit--I looked at the ads for the top seven races that overperformed Kamala Harris, and [found](https://the-antimonopolist.ghost.io/r/996763ed?m=46b412a0-1cbe-4fcb-b85d-2477ce9f4e21) that in all but one, the candidates made a big deal out of opposing mergers or taking on corporate monopolies. This year, there are a number of exciting Congressional candidates, I want to highlight two in tough primaries, so you can learn more about them and support them:
1. Reed Showalter
2. Dylan Hewitt

Reed has worked in Congress investigating the monopolistic abuses of Big Tech, blocked dangerous mergers at the Federal Trade Commission and U.S. Department of Justic,e and pushing back against corporate power in every part of the economy. He knows how corruption works, and he knows how to stop it. I've watched [_Reed 's campaign_](https://the-antimonopolist.ghost.io/r/9792f791?m=46b412a0-1cbe-4fcb-b85d-2477ce9f4e21) closely, and what stands out is simple: **he tells the truth about who is rigging the system, and he 's not afraid to name names.** It matters because working people in IL-7 deserve a champion who won't shrink from a fight.But Reed is up against a political machine that has money, name recognition, and every establishment advantage. Please**make a donation today to help Reed Showalter flip IL-7:**
> [**DONATE NOW**](https://the-antimonopolist.ghost.io/r/829ea499?m=46b412a0-1cbe-4fcb-b85d-2477ce9f4e21)****
Dylan Hewitt is ready to take on the big bullies, support local jobs, and power the local economy in one of my favorite areas of America, the North Country of New York. He supports Medicare for All and sees corporate consolidation for what it is: a direct attack on our freedom, our democracy, and our economic future. He rejects AIPAC money and Super PAC politics--and will be an amazing replacement for Elise StefanikBut Reed is up against a political machine that has money, name recognition, and every establishment advantage. So please **make a donation today to help Dylan Hewitt flip NY-21:**
> [**DONATE NOW**](https://the-antimonopolist.ghost.io/r/308af3cb?m=46b412a0-1cbe-4fcb-b85d-2477ce9f4e21)
I'll be honest--I can't promise you either will win. But I can promise that both have a real chance and that the Democratic party needs a whole new generation of corporate trustbusters if we are going to have a democracy!Hope you're well,Zephyr

When I was growing up in Bethel, salmon fishing with my father in the summers and dog mushing in the winters, Alaska was a place of abundance.

Now, all across Alaska, we have scarcity.

Multi-national companies are trawling our waters and decimating our fish stocks. The moose, caribou, and migratory birds that used to fill our freezers are harder to find.

So we buy more groceries, where the prices are just crushing Alaska families.

And I've got to tell you, DC people do not care that we are paying 17 bucks for a gallon of milk. They don’t even believe us.

By Illinois Review

Illinois taxpayers are getting their first clear look at how deeply the insider game runs in Springfield – and the numbers are staggering.

On Monday, Republican gubernatorial candidate Darren Bailey formally launched his campaign’s new Transparency Tracker, an initiative designed to expose waste, fraud, and abuse after years of one-party Democratic control.

The tracker is part of Bailey’s pledge to establish DOGE Illinois on day one if elected, with his lieutenant governor nominee Aaron Del Mar serving as the state’s DOGE Czar.

The first disclosure detonated like a political bomb: $8.8 million in taxpayer funds spent on “Hyatt hotel infrastructure improvements” in Fiscal Year 2023.

The spending immediately raised alarms because the property involved is tied directly to Democratic Gov. JB Pritzker, a billionaire heir to the Hyatt fortune.

But that figure is only the tip of the iceberg.

According to documented records, total taxpayer-funded investments in the Hyatt Regency McCormick Place from 2011 through 2025 now exceed $180 million.

Ted Dabrowski during a press conference in Chicago on Jan. 6, 2026. (Antonio Perez/Chicago Tribune)
By Illinois Review

For much of the 2026 gubernatorial campaign, Ted Dabrowski has been clear and consistent about what he believes is Illinois’ most pressing issue.

Property taxes, Dabrowski has said repeatedly, are the number one issue facing Illinois residents.

While campaigning across the state, Dabrowski described property taxes as voters’ “number-one concern” and made affordability the foundation of his platform. His campaign materials emphasized reducing the tax burden on homeowners, seniors, and working families, arguing that high property taxes are a primary driver of population loss and economic stagnation.

The message aligned closely with his background as a financial policy analyst and longtime critic of government spending.

That focus defined the early phase of his campaign.

However, recent polling suggests the message has not translated into voter support. A WGN-TV poll released recently shows Dabrowski trailing significantly in the Republican primary.

Former state Sen. Darren Bailey, the current frontrunner, leads Dabrowski by a wide margin – 34 percent to 8 percent – a 26-point gap that has raised questions about Dabrowski’s campaign strategy and momentum.

As those numbers became public, the campaign’s messaging began to shift.

Over the weekend, Dabrowski aired a new television advertisement during Saturday night’s Chicago Bears playoff matchup against the Green Bay Packers – one of the most watched and emotionally charged rivalries in professional football. Political strategists estimate the prime-time placement likely cost the campaign approximately $170,000, underscoring both the high stakes of the moment and the urgency behind the messaging change.

The commercial made no mention of property taxes or fiscal reform. Instead, it focused on violent crime and sharply criticized Democratic Gov. JB Pritzker over Illinois’ sanctuary state policies.

The ad featured Joe Abraham, the father of Katie Abraham, who was killed in a drunk-driving crash involving an illegal immigrant, Julio Cucul-Bol. The message argued that sanctuary policies, along with decisions by judges and prosecutors, have increased risks for Illinois families.

name: Roy Cooper
subject: Not every time. But maybe today?
body:
I’d like to count on your support right now.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/2365?source=&t=1&akid=340%2E124072%2Ewb82fW)
Hi Peter — I know I ask for your help a lot, and I know a donation might not always fit in your budget. **I do not expect you to give every time I ask.** In fact, only a fraction of people give to any of our emails — but they remain the best way for us to connect with the supporters who are powering our work, so we really value each one! **[I am asking you to give today (even a small donation will help) not because I want to, but because I have to. If you’re with me already, can I count you in for a contribution before our mid-January deadline?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/4323?t=7&akid=340%2E124072%2Ewb82fW)** The fact is, the GOP’s attention is on us. They see our campaign as the biggest threat to their Senate majority, so they have far-right PACs and mega-donors lined up to pour money into North Carolina on behalf of our MAGA opponents. Peter, we’re taking the far-right on with grassroots donations from folks here in NC and across the country. This month, the average gift we receive on emails like this one is **$24.42**. It just goes to show that individual supporters really can make all the difference, even in ultra-competitive races like ours. I’ve been humbled to receive so much support from so many folks over the course of this campaign. Knowing I have you with me makes all the hard days on the campaign trail worth it. I’m deeply grateful. But there’s still a long road ahead, and we cannot afford to slow down. **[I’m asking you to give today so that we can keep up the work tomorrow and through the months ahead. Donate anything you can here.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/4323?t=8&akid=340%2E124072%2Ewb82fW)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/4324?t=9&akid=340%2E124072%2Ewb82fW)

We can win this together. Thanks for being with me.
Roy Cooper
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/4323?t=15&akid=340%2E124072%2Ewb82fW)
* * *
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY KARRIN FOR ARIZONA
body:
Girls' Sports Are For Girls. Period.

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** January 13th, 2026

**Karrin Taylor Robson Calls on Supreme Court to Protect Women’s Sports** _“Girls’ Sports Are For Girls. Period.”_
**PHOENIX** — The U.S. Supreme Court is hearing arguments this morning in cases that could reshape Title IX and women’s sports nationwide. Karrin Taylor Robson, Trump-endorsed candidate for Governor of Arizona, issued the following statement:
_“As a mother and grandmother, I’m praying the Supreme Court does the right thing today and protects women’s sports. Title IX was created to protect girls and give them a fair shot, not to be hijacked by woke activists who want to pretend biology doesn’t exist. Girls’ sports are for girls. Period. I’m urging the Court to uphold Title IX, reject this radical gender ideology, and protect fairness, safety, and opportunity for our daughters and granddaughters.”_
The Supreme Court’s decision in the cases heard today is expected later this year and could set national precedent on how Title IX applies to sex-based athletic competition.
---
[|
---](https://karrinforarizona.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=473c144f5f100c2eff990c077&id=ebf05f277b&e=ebfb0fda52)
| |
**About Karrin Taylor Robson** Karrin Taylor Robson is a lifelong conservative and business executive running for Governor of Arizona with President Trump’s endorsement.
Just like President Trump, Karrin is not a politician; she is a self-made business executive who has built one of the state’s leading land-use and economic development firms. Her work has helped bring jobs, opportunity, and growth to Arizona while cutting through bureaucracy and fighting government overreach. She’s also served on key military and education boards that impact Arizona families every day, including for more than 20 years on the Air Force Chief of Staff’s Civic Leaders Group.
A proud wife, mother of four, and grandmother, Karrin is running for Governor to keep our communities safe, fix, root out waste, fraud, and abuse in Arizona, and she will always have President Trump's back.

Dear USO Supporter,
Our service members give their all for us, often serving in remote locations around the world, far from their homes and loved ones. They put their lives at risk to keep us safe -- 365 days a year.
For 85 years, the USO has had a singular mission: to strengthen the well-being of the people serving in America's military and their families. And today -- more than ever -- that mission matters. Our men and women in uniform are deployed to remote, dangerous corners of the world -- often with little notice, limited communication with loved ones and enormous stress on their shoulders.
**Fewer than 1% of Americans serve in uniform. Yet they defend 100% of us.**
**[That's why we're asking dedicated military supporters like you to join an elite group of donors called the USO Home Team with a monthly donation -- or whatever amount is right for you -- to provide life-changing support for our heroes throughout the year.](https://links.e.uso.)**
The USO is the only nonprofit organization tasked with being there -- wherever they serve -- providing a true home away from home. At forward operating bases like Camp Lemonnier, at airfields, aboard ships and in combat zones, the USO delivers something no one else does:
* A welcoming place to rest and recharge
* A reminder of home, dignity and humanity
* A moment of connection in the middle of sacrifice

**[Can we count you in?](https://links.e.uso.)**

| | Peter Willis, For years, **Washington has been broken** — and Kansas families, seniors, businesses are paying the price.

Under Joe Biden we had: Open borders. Runaway spending. Radical policies that weakened our economy, undermined parents, and put politics ahead of public safety.

But now, with Republican leadership back in charge, we finally have a real chance to start setting things right.

And Tracey Mann is on the front lines of that fight.

This year, our focus is clear:
* Continue to **lock down the border** and stop fentanyl and human trafficking
* Rein in reckless federal spending and r**estore fiscal sanity**
* Lower costs and **remove red tape** for Kansas families and small businesses
* **Stand firm for parents, faith, and freedom**
* **Defend the Constitution** and Kansas values

This is the moment to take our country back — and it won’t happen without a strong grassroots movement behind it.

If you’re able, will you [chip in today](https://traceymann.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60a16ea89a176679a5f31366c&id=33e9280762&e=a9d1410029) to help fuel the fight?

body:

---
Peter,
2026 is off to a horrendous start.
Trump invaded Venezuela and kidnapped their president, threatened to do the same in Cuba, Mexico, and Columbia, it was reported he ordered military brass to draw up a plan to invade Greenland, just today threatened to bomb Iran, is prosecuting Jerome Powell to take control of the independent Federal Reserve, and is covering up the murder of Renee Good in Minnesota by an ICE agent.
And it's only been 13 days into the New Year.
We desperately need a Congress who will step in and put the clamps on Trump's insanity to prevent more foreign wars, investigate and prosecute his administration's crimes, and keep the economy from cratering.
And there is good news, bad news on that front.
The good news is that Democrats have an opportunity to take back Congress this year.
The bad news is...
---
| [](https://6s79z9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001sRrqJkWrzuN2vIssbbemRHnTyLrWAJn7qmGohZqZ0NKlrNPBW5pnzO8l3QKpjdnf2QKCDnB7oMqfyXqJDXR2pYh2GmbVDMBemGIUl7ebxXmdSMXGIGadtHO0pQmHGfu0ksaND22K4Gq2MADW9tz6ds3QYHxw0JSJUkaMykg45Ro0svIiV6726M2TJKif53NhidczT48oHlrMfRjgrghDAg==&c=V3Prbc7wEMCyrakgvXxuQ8C_lpaYP6UQRJoCTn5tD_fqEHnN2q2zIQ==&ch=kxaWlBQPOi68fwbd82pzfSrGMAIsYEgqRB2a8mJ7SHbF4yUd-uvH4Q==)
---
The chance for Democrats to pump the brakes on Trump's insanity before this country crashes and burns is in major jeopardy.
The court is expected to issue a decision on a key portion of the Voting Rights Act any day now, and if they strike down the law, it will give Republicans a significant advantage to keep control of the House for decades to come.
But there is still hope, if Democrats fight back and redraw districts of their own, they can swing the math back in favor of Democrats and prevent MAGA from locking in one party rule regardless of how the Supreme Court rules.
That's why what Colorado Draws the Line is doing is the X-Factor for Democrats. We are spearheading a ballot initiative that would give Democrats 3-4 additional seats in Congress in Colorado.
But MAGA knows what we are doing has the chance to stop their election rigging scheme in its tracks, so they are gearing up to spend millions to defeat us before the initiative even makes it on the ballot. If Democrats from across the country rally to our cause right now, we'll be able to defeat anything they throw at us.

Last week, a U.S. citizen – and mother of 3 – was brutally murdered by an ICE agent in Minneapolis.

It is a horrifying tragedy – one that was both predictable and preventable. My heart breaks for her family, her loved ones, and a community now grieving a loss that never should have occurred.
For months, armed ICE and CBP agents have been roaming American cities, detaining and assaulting U.S. citizens with little to no accountability. Warnings were raised. Evidence was presented. And yet, the abuse continued – until it turned deadly.

This is not an isolated incident.

Last month, I held a spotlight forum in D.C. to shed light on the alarming trend of U.S. citizens being illegally detained, mistreated, and even assaulted by federal immigration agents – oftentimes with those citizens _having valid proof of their citizenship._
So what did we expose at this hearing?
• School superintendent Wilmer Chavarria was detained, interrogated for hours, and searched because he visited family overseas.

• Dayanne Figueroa was sideswiped, violently pulled from her car, and detained, simply for going to work.

• Javier Ramirez was assaulted, held for days, and denied treatment for diabetes.

• U.S. Army veteran George Retes was arrested and detained while attempting to enter his workplace, forcing him to miss his daughter’s birthday with no contact with his family.
Now, we have to add what happened in Minneapolis to this list – an inevitable consequence of allowing lawless conduct to go unanswered. This is why I am **committed to holding ICE and the administration accountable, ensuring transparent oversight, and passing reform to protect the people living in our nation. **

We must stand together and be firm. The same spirit that unites us in moments of tragedy like this now calls on us to defend other Americans from experiencing these same abuses of power. [ stdin# ]Our Revolution Logo

Peter Willis,

Instead of facing accountability for Renee Good's murder, right now ICE is
INCREASING its presence in Minneapolis — with agents going door to door,
spreading terror and violence.

As the horror spreads nationwide, Democratic leaders Chuck Schumer and
Hakeem Jeffries can't keep waiting for the "right moment" to rein in ICE.
We need to tell them: the right moment is right NOW.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34938?source=email-20260113&t=1011&akid=10075%2E5885482%2Ep-RLsc ]Headline: The latest: Immigration officers out in force in Minnesota
with more on the way following fatal shooting

It's not just Minnesota. Across the country, communities are bracing for
more violence and fear as ICE, emboldened and heavily armed, is unleashed
on families and neighbors.

We cannot allow this chaos to escalate – and the only thing standing
between ICE and even more unchecked power is Congress, which is racing to
pass a budget bill this month. Democrats are increasingly demanding we
slash ICE funding – but so far Democratic leadership is refusing to use
the budget fight as leverage to rein in ICE.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34938?source=email-20260113&t=1012&akid=10075%2E5885482%2Ep-RLsc ]Tell Schumer and Jeffries: Stand up and use the budget fight to rein in
ICE's violence and terror.

The House GOP is pushing a Homeland Security spending bill that would mean
even MORE money and firepower sent straight to ICE and their agents –
agents who are already targeting homes, schools, workplaces, and entire
neighborhoods with zero oversight.

Progressive champions in Congress are demanding real accountability,
calling on Democratic leaders to use every tool at their disposal –
including the government funding deadline – to force ICE to stand down.
But so far, Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer and House Minority Leader
Hakeem Jeffries are refusing to get on board.

Renee Good's killing isn't just a tragedy – it's a warning. If we do
nothing, the terror ICE brings to our neighborhoods will only rise. Let's
make our voices impossible to ignore. Stand with Our Revolution and demand
real action to stop ICE NOW.

body:
Here's why I'm more determined than ever to keep going.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123252775/594846817/1328794144?refcode=ea.09b12bfa-a4f0-f011-8194-000d3a11f903&ms=ea.09b12bfa-a4f0-f011-8194-000d3a11f903&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA5YjEyYmZhLWE0ZjAtZjAxMS04MTk0LTAwMGQzYTExZjkwMyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wsHyb-YMkgZ2j3lCklaA59xEbWbZdV3OcnyGfb1Xmzk=&emci=43c77c24-98f0-f011-8194-000d3a11f903&emdi=09b12bfa-a4f0-f011-8194-000d3a11f903&ceid=4823105)
---
At 88, I've lived through enough to recognize the warning signs. I've seen presidents lie us into wars. I've watched administrations crack down on dissent. I've been arrested numerous times for speaking out for what’s right. But what Trump is doing right now is different. _He's operating without any constraints whatsoever._ Last week, he told _The New York Times_ that his **“own morality”** is the only thing limiting his power. Not Congress. Not the courts. Not international law. Just his personal judgment. And he's acting on it. At every turn, it's something worse. **An ICE agent kills a U.S. citizen, and Trump lies about it. He withdraws America from the foundational global climate treaty, making us the only country on Earth refusing to cooperate on the climate crisis. He launches an illegal war to seize Venezuela's oil reserves and protect the very fossil fuel corporations that poured $1 billion into his campaign.** Look, I don't want to list every horror because you're hearing enough of that in the news. But as I often say, only the lucky grow old — and with that luck comes responsibility. The responsibility to bear witness. To organize. To refuse to be silenced or to retreat. **What we’re seeing is authoritarianism in real time.** And while we can't control what Trump does, we _can_ control who stands between him and our communities. We can elect brave leaders to Congress who will confront bullies. Leaders who will block Trump’s fossil fuel giveaways, defend our democracy, and refuse to be intimidated. **[That's the work my Climate PAC is leading right now, and we need your help to keep supporting the kinds of leaders who can meet this moment. We've set a goal to raise $20,000 by this Thursday to power this work and help flip the House of Representatives in November. clean_body: Here's why I'm more determined than ever to keep going. | At 88, I've lived through enough to recognize the warning signs. I've seen presidents lie us into wars. I've watched administrations crack down on dissent. I've been arrested numerous times for speaking out for what’s right. But what Trump is doing right now is different. He's operating without any constraints whatsoever. Last week, he told The New York Times that his “own morality” is the only thing limiting his power. Not Congress. Not the courts. Not international law. Just his personal judgment. And he's acting on it. At every turn, it's something worse. An ICE agent kills a U.S. citizen, and Trump lies about it. He withdraws America from the foundational global climate treaty, making us the only country on Earth refusing to cooperate on the climate crisis. He launches an illegal war to seize Venezuela's oil reserves and protect the very fossil fuel corporations that poured $1 billion into his campaign. Look, I don't want to list every horror because you're hearing enough of that in the news. But as I often say, only the lucky grow old — and with that luck comes responsibility. The responsibility to bear witness. To organize. To refuse to be silenced or to retreat. What we’re seeing is authoritarianism in real time. And while we can't control what Trump does, we can control who stands between him and our communities. We can elect brave leaders to Congress who will confront bullies. Peter,
In February, the 2026 short legislative session will commence, leaving our elected officials with a great opportunity to take action for our climate, wildlife, and to hold polluters accountable. Our work has already started, and our staff are currently at the Capitol speaking to lawmakers about our 2026 Priorities for a Healthy Oregon [https://olcveducationfund.org/2026-legislative-session/] . Peter, I need your help to make sure our team has the resources it needs to secure big wins for our environment this year.
Give now [https://secure.everyaction.com/YnnBhNxoe0-gdDf_E1iL8Q2?am=20&amtOpts=&recurringAm=20&recurringAmtOpts=&is_optimized_ask=true&contactdata=5YDIoEftVFw27YMR9BjXFD1FLznWy9GNIwCEAy5gGHFXLTIRq1VLJW0IxW924aYFBmkeS/9F4dzEmwmjuEcBmshUzq/p/4B7uW8E3aGJHateFz6SbpnCA2dSWD1319V9]
This session we’ll be working to pass landmark wildlife and habitat conservation funding, a bill to hold polluters responsible for harming our climate, and to protect investments in Oregon’s climate, natural resources, clean energy, conservation, and wildlife agencies ( see our 2026 priorities [https://olcveducationfund.org/2026-legislative-session/] ). We can’t achieve this without your support.
Can you start the new year off right by fueling our fight today? We need your gift to start tomorrow strong. [https://secure.everyaction.com/YnnBhNxoe0-gdDf_E1iL8Q2]
Any amount you give today will go towards building a livable future for our people and planet. Your gift mobilizes our volunteers and community to speak directly with elected officials, and speak out for our climate. A gift of $50 helps us recruit 3 new volunteers. That one gift is equal to a hundred conversations to advocate for climate action.
Your donation is much more than generous, it is an investment in a climate safe and healthy future for all of us. Let’s start the new year strong together! [https://secure.everyaction.com/YnnBhNxoe0-gdDf_E1iL8Q2]
With determination,

body:
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2026%2E791427%2EbDtk7s)
Friend, these are accounts from Minnesota in just the days since the murder of Renee Good. Please read on.
ICE agents at a Target in Richfield, Minnesota, grabbed a teenage employee who was heckling them — as is your legal right — and threw him to the ground. They shoved him in a van and drove away.
The boy was an American citizen who was yelling that he had his passport in his pocket. They didn’t listen until he was detained. Since they had no authority to arrest him, agents dumped him in a Walmart parking lot down the road with no way to get home. He was found injured, bleeding, and crying for help. A child.
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-jan26-ice.iTCV84&refcode=em260113-1-180&t=2&akid=2026%2E791427%2EbDtk7s)
Christian Molina, a Latino man and US citizen, was driving to work in South Minneapolis when ICE agents crashed into his car to force him to stop. Why? Because he looked “illegal.” Christian refused to cooperate with the illegal stop. When neighbors came to the scene to observe and support, ICE tear gassed the crowd and left.
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-jan26-ice.iTCV84&refcode=em260113-1-180&t=3&akid=2026%2E791427%2EbDtk7s)
_Christian Molina’s car after ICE rammed into him._
At a gas station in St. Paul, a man was practicing his legal right to film and observe ICE activities when an ICE agent randomly grabbed him. More agents came over and violently threw him to the ground, arrested him, and dragged him away to an unmarked van. **Arrested for exercising his First Amendment rights.**
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-jan26-ice.iTCV84&refcode=em260113-1-180&t=4&akid=2026%2E791427%2EbDtk7s)
At an electric car charging station in Minneapolis, ICE agents went car to car looking for people of color, asking each to prove they were citizens or risk being dragged away.

At a protest in Minneapolis, multiple masked ICE agents detained a protester and a US citizen by grabbing her by the throat and choking her. She was thrown into an unmarked van and disappeared.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. # Announcing the DNC’s When We Count Voter Registration Youth Fellowship
---
| | To kick-off 2026, the DNC formally [announced](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=ea03ef514e&e=d6c5c7d7ec) today the [**When We Count Youth Fellowship**](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=adf559a978&e=d6c5c7d7ec) – _the largest voter registration effort the committee has ever launched. _This cycle, the DNC has made voter registration a top strategic priority nationwide, recognizing that partisan efforts are essential to reversing recent registration trends, winning in upcoming cycles, and training the next generation of Democratic operatives on this fundamental organizing skill.

**Associated Press** : [Democrats will spend millions to shift voter registration strategy ahead of the midterm elections](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=1053630aaf&e=d6c5c7d7ec)**Arizona Republic** : [National Democrats launch voter registration effort in Arizona](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=e9ad1628cd&e=d6c5c7d7ec)**Nevada Independent:** [Democrats launch seven-figure voter registration campaign in Nevada, Arizona ](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=2988959662&e=d6c5c7d7ec)
---
[|
---](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=36e15cce51&e=d6c5c7d7ec)
| |
**WHEN WE COUNT FELLOWSHIP: **This paid, part-time youth fellowship will train young supporters to register new Democratic voters on the ground, with a particular focus on non-college youth – a group frequently overlooked by traditional youth registration efforts. Considering that nearly 60% of Americans 18-24 are not enrolled in college, this strategic focus fills a gap in the ecosystem and ensures we’re reaching and registering young voters where they live and work.
The first cohorts will launch in spring 2026 across priority congressional districts in Arizona and Nevada. Across districts in these two states, the program will train more than 100 Fellows to register tens of thousands of voters, while building a pipeline of future organizers for the Party.

_**“Affordability should be the focus of every decision in Washington. Lower inflation and falling gas prices show what is possible when leadership gets priorities right, but there is still more work to do. Florida families deserve an economy that works for them, not against them.”– Justin Story**_

| | **January 13, 2026****Contact: justin@votejustinstory.com**
---
| |
(St. Cloud, Florida) - Today, Justin Story, Republican candidate for Congress in Florida’s 9th Congressional District, responded to new economic data showing Core CPI coming in at 2.6 percent, the lowest inflation rate since March 2021. “Today’s inflation report is welcome news for American families. At 2.6 percent, core inflation is at its lowest level in nearly five years. Less than one year into his second term, President Trump has already made significant progress reversing the damage caused by four years of reckless spending and inflation under Joe Biden.” Story noted that easing inflation is beginning to show up in real-world costs, including gas prices across Central Florida, which have fallen sharply over the past year. “Families are seeing relief at the pump, and that matters. Lower gas prices help working parents get to their jobs, help small businesses control costs, and reduce pressure throughout the economy.” However, Story cautioned that inflation progress alone is not enough. “While inflation is coming down, too many Florida families are still struggling with high grocery bills and an out-of-reach housing market. Washington cannot declare victory until the cost of food comes down and homeownership is achievable again for middle-class families.” Story said when in Congress he will fight to build on recent progress by promoting energy independence, cutting wasteful federal spending, and supporting policies that cut regulations and lower costs for families. “Affordability should be the focus of every decision in Washington. Lower inflation and falling gas prices show what is possible when leadership gets priorities right, but there is still more work to do. Florida families deserve an economy that works for them, not against them.” Justin Story is a retired U.S. Marine Corps officer, husband, father, and sixth-generation Central Floridian running for Congress in Florida’s 9th Congressional District. | | | | | | Peter,
As we head into the March 3, 2026, Republican primary, Texas is at a critical crossroads. With an open seat in CD-21 and our state facing real challenges—from an unsecured border fueling drugs and crime to runaway federal spending and the need to protect our constitutional rights—Texas needs strong, experienced leadership in Washington now more than ever.
That's why I sat down for an in-depth conversation on the **Vote Like a Texan** series with host Justin McKenzie.
---
[|
---](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=44679a50d8&e=4d3fe76c62)

This is a substantive discussion about the issues that matter most to us here in TX-21 — not soundbites, but real plans to secure our border, cut wasteful spending, uphold life and the 2nd Amendment, and protect our elections.
The primary is where the decision is made in our solidly Republican district. Your vote on March 3 will determine who represents us in Congress. I'm asking for your support because I've spent my career on the front lines fighting for these values — and I'm ready to take that fight to Washington for TX-21.

1. **Share** the video with friends, family, and neighbors in the district

Together, we can send a proven conservative fighter to Congress who will stand with President Trump and deliver for Texas families.
Thank you for your time, your trust, and your commitment to our great state.
For Texas,

name: Eileen for Colorado
subject: Eileen knows that Colorado’s farmland should be held by Americans, not foreign corporations
body:
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | [|
---](https://mailchi.mp/67e31b76f56e/lauren-boebert-voted-no-on-investing-in-farmers-ranchers-and-rural-communities-15534236?e=1c5f08419c)
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | **Throughout the United States, a total of 45 million acres of land are owned and controlled by foreign investors.** Colorado has seen an increasing trend towards foreign and corporate ownership of local farmlands, with **over 2.5 million acres of Colorado’s land being held by foreign-owned absentee investors.** _Colorado ranks as having the third-largest amount of foreign-owned and absentee agricultural land in the United States._
This directly harms our local farmers and ranchers, who are currently being subjected to unfair competition from multinational corporations**** acquiring Colorado’s farmlands. **When these corporations can outbid local producers, they also drive up the cost of land and drive out farmers and families who have been producing our food for generations.** Eileen believes in supporting our local farmers and their families — and this includes a commitment to banning foreign ownership of farmland. **American farmers deserve access to American lands, not unfair competition from foreign corporations who drive them out of business and seek to concentrate land ownership and influence our food supply.**
---
|
---
| | **Local food producers are integral parts of our economies and communities** , and they deserve protection and support.**** That’s exactly why Eileen will fight to ensure stronger protections for our farmers— a fight rooted in support for locally owned farmlands.
Colorado’s ranchers and farmers are entitled to representatives who side with them and not the corporations who seek to displace them. American farmland should always support American farmers who are devoted to protecting our food supply— not absentee investors who have no personal stake in our communities.
Eileen understands that land ownership is a central part of ensuring security for our future generations. **Our farmers and ranchers deserve a fair shot at building a future for their families and legacies.**
**This is why Eileen plans to...**
* **🥊 Fight back against absentee farmland ownership.**
**🌾 Ensure that land is affordable and accessible** to farmers, ranchers, and small businesses.
**🍽️ Protect food security** by defending the farmers who have been putting food on our tables for generations.
**🚫 Stand up to corporations** who price out local farmers and hurt our local economies.

---
|
---
| | **Congress has been serving the interests of corporations for too long.** Supporting Eileen means supporting a change in this system. Eileen is not a career politician in the pocket of multinational corporate interest,**** she is a concerned citizen who is ready to defend and represent our farmers and ranchers in the halls of Congress. **Our district is ready for a new and fresh representative who can stand up to corporate greed while strengthening rural economies for future generations— Eileen is up to this task.**

---
| | | | | | | | | | | | [**Join Eileen**](https://eileenforcolorado.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=400e8fa21dba23169b817268c&id=a07fb337ea&e=1c5f08419c)** in the fight to support our local farmers and ranchers by standing up to corporate interest. **
---
| |
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | **About our “What’s at Stake” Series** This newsletter focuses on what is on the line for Colorado if Lauren Boebert remains in Congress. Each edition highlights a real issue facing families in our district, what is driving the problem, and how leadership in Washington can make a tangible difference. From rising health care costs to threats to rural hospitals to the economic pressures on working families, the stakes in this election are real.
**We encourage you to share** these newsletters with friends, neighbors, and on social media so our community can have informed, honest conversations about what this election means for the future of Colorado’s Fourth District

Fellow Patriot,

Long before I ever put on a badge, I made a simple promise to myself:

When something is broken, you don't complain - _you fix it._

That philosophy guided me through eight years as Sheriff. It's why I stood up to cartels, why I defended our border communities, and why I backed our deputies even when it wasn't politically convenient.

But today, something bigger is broken.

Washington has stopped listening to the people who make this country work. Not the lobbyists. Not the bureaucrats. _The people_.

The ranchers who wake up before dawn. The small business owners who sign both sides of the paycheck. The parents who are fighting to protect their kids' future. The families who still believe in God, Family, and Freedom.
