clean_body: When something is broken, you don't complain — you fix it. | Fellow Patriot, Long before I ever put on a badge, I made a simple promise to myself: When something is broken, you don't complain - you fix it. That philosophy guided me through eight years as Sheriff. It's why I stood up to cartels, why I defended our border communities, and why I backed our deputies even when it wasn't politically convenient. But today, something bigger is broken. Washington has stopped listening to the people who make this country work. Not the lobbyists. Not the bureaucrats. The people. The ranchers who wake up before dawn. The small business owners who sign both sides of the paycheck. The parents who are fighting to protect their kids' future. The families who still believe in God, Family, and Freedom. They deserve a voice that won't fold when things get tough. That's why I'm running for Congress - not to join the political class, but to challenge it. To restore the kind of leadership that answers to the people, not to the unelected and unaccountable. And I'm going to fight for that every single day. But I can't do it alone. name: Mark Kelly
subject: This wasn’t a decision I made lightly
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
Freedom of speech, separation of powers, due process — these aren’t just words on a page. They are the bedrock principles of our democracy. We have to defend them.
#

The last few months haven’t been easy, friends.
When I learned that Pete Hegseth was coming for my rank, I had to make a decision I never expected. I’d like to tell you about it, if you’ll listen.
From the time I drove through the gates of Naval Air Station Pensacola until I landed Space Shuttle Endeavour on its final mission, I gave a lot to this country.
When Hegseth censured me and threatened my rank and retirement, he came after what I earned over 25 years — and chilled the rights of every retired member of the military alongside me.
If Hegseth isn’t stopped, our longest-serving military veterans will have to live with the constant threat that they could be deprived of their rank and pension years — even decades — after they leave the military if they say something he doesn’t like.
Freedom of speech, separation of powers, due process — these aren’t just words on a page. They are the bedrock principles of our democracy. We have to defend them.
So, I decided to sue the Secretary of Defense. It’s a serious step, but I couldn’t let this stand.
Now, if I’ve learned anything about Trump and Hegseth over the last year, it’s that it’s impossible to know what they’re going to throw my way next.
What I do know is I’m going to need my top supporters with me, come what may.
[**So, I’m humbly asking you: Please, chip in to support me as I fight these relentless attacks from Trump and his team.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-jan26-dod.oeiXQe&refcode=em260113-1-90&t=1&akid=6331%2E6688874%2EBhCaHK)

# Trump blasts Powell demands massive rate slash
President Donald Trump seized on Tuesday's consumer price data showing steady inflation to renew his aggressive push for Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell **[to cut interest rates"meaningfully,"](https://substack.com/redirect/fcd1b160-b487-4367-b29e-dd5279dfcee9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** labeling him "Jerome 'Too Late' Powell" and warning further delays would prove costly amid ongoing economic tensions.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fcd1b160-b487-4367-b29e-dd5279dfcee9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Inflation numbers stable:** December CPI held firm, with core inflation unchanged at 2.6% annually and 0.2% monthly, slightly below economist forecasts and reversing prior distortions from government shutdown effects.
* **Trump celebrates growth:** President Trump hailed accompanying "GREAT GROWTH NUMBERS" and credited his tariff policies as "MISTER TARIFF" for driving positive economic momentum.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/76b2c2d6-fd14-4d8b-a268-354f22ea8043?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Fed faces unchanged outlook:** Data reinforced market expectations that the Federal Reserve would hold interest rates steady at its upcoming meeting, despite recent cuts in the prior year.
* **Pressure intensifies on Powell:** Trump's Truth Social post escalated his long-standing criticism, insisting low inflation proves the need for deeper, immediate rate reductions to avoid being "TOO LATE."

# Inflation cools further, Core measure hits slowest pace since 2021
US inflation eased in December 2025 as core consumer prices -- excluding volatile food and energy -- **[rose at their slowest annual pace](https://substack.com/redirect/0e084a78-9ea3-4606-acfa-e8a93fd975c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** since March 2021, climbing just 2.6% year-over-year while headline CPI held steady at 2.7%, matching expectations and reinforcing a downward trend amid moderating underlying pressures.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0e084a78-9ea3-4606-acfa-e8a93fd975c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Food Prices Surge Notably:** Food index jumped 0.7% monthly outpacing overall inflation with five of six major grocery categories rising despite a 0.2% drop in meat prices.
* **Used Vehicles Drag Core Lower:** Used cars and trucks plunged 1.7% in December helping temper core CPI gains alongside declines in airline fares and transportation services.
* **Core Inflation Moderates Genuinely:** Annual core rate held at 2.6% equaling November's level with economists noting true easing in underlying pressures despite some prior data volatility.
* **Fed Rate Cut Odds Fade:** Markets priced in 95% chance of unchanged rates at the January 2026 meeting as inflation drifts lower but stays above the 2% target less pressing than labor risks.

# Microsoft vows no electricity hikes from AI data centers
Microsoft pledged Tuesday that **[local consumers won't face higher electricity bills](https://substack.com/redirect/dd810889-bc6e-4e57-90eb-dc35263d2697?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** when it builds massive AI-powered data centers nearby, committing to pay elevated utility rates and fund infrastructure expansions amid surging U.S. power costs driven by the tech industry's AI boom.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dd810889-bc6e-4e57-90eb-dc35263d2697?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Pays premium utility rates** Microsoft will negotiate higher electricity rates with utilities to fully cover its data center power needs and prevent cost pass-through to residents.
* **Funds grid infrastructure** The company plans advanced deals with utilities to invest in adding electricity supply, addressing shortages from explosive AI demand.
* **Replenishes water excess** Beyond energy, Microsoft commits to restoring more water than its facilities consume and boosting local tax revenues without seeking property tax breaks.
* **Doubles data center scale** With plans to nearly double its footprint in the next two years and $35 billion in recent AI infrastructure spending, the pledges aim to ease community opposition and speed deployments.

# JPMorgan smashes expectations despite profit dip
JPMorgan Chase **[beat Wall Street estimates](https://substack.com/redirect/92d72202-fe00-44bb-ad6f-82b17a51dfb3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with adjusted earnings of $5.23 per share and revenue of $46.77 billion in the fourth quarter of 2025, fueled by surging trading gains in equities and fixed income. A $2.2 billion reserve charge tied to absorbing the Apple Card portfolio from Goldman Sachs drove reported profit down 7% to $13.03 billion, pressuring shares lower in early trading.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/92d72202-fe00-44bb-ad6f-82b17a51dfb3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Trading Surge Powers Gains** Robust equities trading jumped 40% to $2.9 billion, outpacing expectations by $350 million, while fixed income rose 7% to $5.4 billion amid favorable market conditions.
* **Investment Banking Lags** Fees declined 5% to $2.3 billion, falling about $210 million short of forecasts and highlighting softer deal-making momentum.
* **2026 Outlook Issued** The bank guided to roughly $103 billion in full-year net interest income and $105 billion in adjusted expenses, both dependent on market developments.
* **Dimon Sees Resilient Economy** CEO Jamie Dimon noted softening but stable labor markets, sustained consumer spending, and potential boosts from deregulation and fiscal stimulus, while warning of geopolitical and inflation risks.

* * *
* * *
# The California wealth tax is so bad that Newsom comes out against it
California Gov. Gavin Newsom **[condemned a proposed 5% one-time wealth tax](https://substack.com/redirect/6b536cf7-76b9-4869-a6f2-28e12dbab5c7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on billionaires as "really damaging" to the state Monday, warning that its mere introduction is already prompting the ultra-wealthy--including tech titans like Larry Page and Sergey Brin--to shift money and businesses elsewhere amid fears of the looming 2026 ballot measure.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6b536cf7-76b9-4869-a6f2-28e12dbab5c7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Wealth tax targets** billionaires with over $1 billion in assets, imposing a one-time 5% levy due in 2027, potentially payable over five years with interest, and applying retroactively to California residents as of January 1, 2026.
* **Newsom vows opposition** declaring the proposal "makes no sense" and "bad economics," predicting its defeat due to widespread resistance and emphasizing his pragmatic agenda against such measures in his final year.
* **Billionaires relocating** assets including Google co-founder Larry Page moving business entities and buying Miami properties, Oracle's Larry Ellison selling his San Francisco home, and others like **[Sergey Brin](https://substack.com/redirect/effc52a4-1519-47b1-a832-d216790d17ee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and Peter Thiel shifting operations out of state.
* **Economic fallout feared** with Newsom citing real impacts on revenue, startups, long-term investments, and heightened uncertainty, as the tax risks driving away innovation and commitments crucial to California's economy.

body:
Join Us for Our Monthly Webinar!

Foundational Biological Substrates for Autism & Toxicity: What They Are and How to Use Them Safely

We are excited to invite you to our upcoming educational webinar featuring Dr. Krishna Doniparthi with Functional Medicine Georgia (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/www.fmg.health%2Fdrdoniparthi/b43o/ULLCAQ/AQ/f3f03153-87ac-4a85-96a3-dc666934b8c4/1/x6na7YDFeB?mc_cid=1abc1b8d41&mc_eid=UNIQID) , a respected physician recognized for his expertise in functional and integrative medicine, with a focus on complex chronic conditions and neurological health.

In this informative session, Dr. Doniparthi will explore the foundational biological substrates that play a critical role in autism, toxicity, and overall neurological function. Understanding and supporting these core systems is essential for safe and effective healing, especially for individuals with heightened sensitivities.

This webinar is designed for parents, caregivers, professionals, and health-conscious individuals seeking science-based, thoughtful approaches to supporting children and families impacted by autism and environmental toxicity.

Date: Saturday, January 17th
Time: 9:00 AM (PST)

We hope you’ll join us for this valuable educational opportunity as we continue our mission to empower families through knowledge, integrity, and compassionate care.
REGISTER HERE (https://us06web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_9oWHI_K_S36gG9vCPKLFZA?mc_cid=1abc1b8d41&mc_eid=UNIQID#/registration)

** The 2026 Autism Health Summit is Almost Here!
------------------------------------------------------------

April 24–26, 2026 | Legacy Center Resort & Spa | San Diego, California

The Autism Health Summit is our flagship educational event, bringing together leading voices in research, medicine, advocacy, and integrative health for three powerful days of learning, connection, and collaboration. This annual gathering is designed for parents, practitioners, researchers, and advocates who are seeking deeper insight into autism and neurological health from a whole-body, whole-family perspective.

We are honored to welcome an extraordinary lineup of speakers, including Aaron Siri, Del Bigtree, Dr. Toby Rogers, Dr. Sabine Hazan, Dr. Dayan Goodenowe, Dr. Brian Hooker, and many more respected experts and thought leaders. Together, they will explore cutting-edge research, clinical insights, environmental factors, and practical strategies that families and professionals can use. For a full list of speakers, click HERE to see our agenda (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/track.pstmrk.it%2F3s%2Fahsconference.com%252Fagenda%252F%2Fb43o%2FXYvCAQ%2FAQ%2Ffb66b930-9caa-4773-b075-95fc5d58a8e8%2F1%2FeR-lkap3k2/b43o/ULLCAQ/AQ/f3f03153-87ac-4a85-96a3-dc666934b8c4/3/UdWQe2RTMZ?mc_cid=1abc1b8d41&mc_eid=UNIQID) .

The Summit will be held at the beautiful Legacy Center Resort & Spa (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/track.pstmrk.it%2F3s%2Flegacyresortandspa.com%2Fb43o%2FXYvCAQ%2FAQ%2Ffb66b930-9caa-4773-b075-95fc5d58a8e8%2F2%2FcmuIWlIP_Q/b43o/ULLCAQ/AQ/f3f03153-87ac-4a85-96a3-dc666934b8c4/4/YrEkOZHG-X?mc_cid=1abc1b8d41&mc_eid=UNIQID) , where attendees can book a room at a special group rate of $199 per night. To reserve your room, please use the conference room block link HERE (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/track.pstmrk.it%2F3s%2Fahsconference.com%252Fhotel%252F%2Fb43o%2FXYvCAQ%2FAQ%2Ffb66b930-9caa-4773-b075-95fc5d58a8e8%2F3%2FR1Eh7nj6ve/b43o/ULLCAQ/AQ/f3f03153-87ac-4a85-96a3-dc666934b8c4/5/BTFLiemYTN?mc_cid=1abc1b8d41&mc_eid=UNIQID) or call (619) 782-9155 and use block code: Autism26. The room block dates are from April 23 to April 26. If you are staying longer, call in and use the discount code.

We are deeply grateful to our top sponsors for their continued support and leadership: Cellular Performance Institute (CPI) (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/track.pstmrk.it%2F3s%2Fcellularperformanceinstitute.com%2Fb43o%2FXYvCAQ%2FAQ%2Ffb66b930-9caa-4773-b075-95fc5d58a8e8%2F4%2FsxItfHHc49/b43o/ULLCAQ/AQ/f3f03153-87ac-4a85-96a3-dc666934b8c4/6/lrYZqbOb7b?mc_cid=1abc1b8d41&mc_eid=UNIQID) , Dr. Goodenowe Enterprises (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/track.pstmrk.it%2F3s%2Fdrgoodenowe.com%2Fb43o%2FXYvCAQ%2FAQ%2Ffb66b930-9caa-4773-b075-95fc5d58a8e8%2F5%2F7zPRt-ypBb/b43o/ULLCAQ/AQ/f3f03153-87ac-4a85-96a3-dc666934b8c4/7/1ZdjdZZ9kW?mc_cid=1abc1b8d41&mc_eid=UNIQID) , European Wellness (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/track.pstmrk.it%2F3s%2Feuropean-wellness.eu%2Fb43o%2FXYvCAQ%2FAQ%2Ffb66b930-9caa-4773-b075-95fc5d58a8e8%2F6%2FUZE-tepvnv/b43o/ULLCAQ/AQ/f3f03153-87ac-4a85-96a3-dc666934b8c4/8/4uOZ0d0JV_?mc_cid=1abc1b8d41&mc_eid=UNIQID) , and Satellite Phone Store (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/satellitephonestore.com/b43o/ULLCAQ/AQ/f3f03153-87ac-4a85-96a3-dc666934b8c4/9/Z9_dXWx6z4?mc_cid=1abc1b8d41&mc_eid=UNIQID) . Their commitment helps make this
event possible and supports ongoing education and outreach within the autism community.

We look forward to welcoming you to San Diego for an unforgettable weekend of education, empowerment, and community.
REGISTER HERE (https://ahsconference.com/pricing-table/?mc_cid=1abc1b8d41&mc_eid=UNIQID)

** Join Us for Our Hearts & Vines Wine Tasting Fundraiser!
------------------------------------------------------------

Please save the date for our Hearts & Vines Fundraiser, an elegant evening benefiting Autism Health Inc., proudly sponsored by Sunstone Winery (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/sunstonewinery.com/b43o/ULLCAQ/AQ/f3f03153-87ac-4a85-96a3-dc666934b8c4/11/XznvJt1YwA?mc_cid=1abc1b8d41&mc_eid=UNIQID) .

Join us on Saturday, February 21st, from 5 PM to 9 PM PST, in San Marcos, CA for a special night of community, connection, and purpose. Guests will enjoy fine wine, delicious hors d'oeuvres, and inspiring presentations from Dr. Sabine Hazan (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/progenabiome.com/b43o/ULLCAQ/AQ/f3f03153-87ac-4a85-96a3-dc666934b8c4/12/lJ9qa2mJAG?mc_cid=1abc1b8d41&mc_eid=UNIQID) and Dr. Dayan Goodenowe (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/drgoodenowe.com/b43o/ULLCAQ/AQ/f3f03153-87ac-4a85-96a3-dc666934b8c4/13/U1OwNhzzKn?mc_cid=1abc1b8d41&mc_eid=UNIQID) , who will share insights on fecal transplant, autism, health, and the most up-to-date research.

Tickets are $95 and include wine, hors d'oeuvres, and complementary wine glass.

This intimate fundraising event supports Autism Health Inc.’s mission to advance education, research, and resources for families affected by autism and neurological disorders.

We look forward to sharing this meaningful evening with you.
REGISTER HERE (https://givebutter.com/2026_HnV?gbtid=83c5dacf-5e5d-4e2e-bbab-463401a888d2&mc_cid=1abc1b8d41&mc_eid=UNIQID)

About Autism Health Inc.
Autism Health is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to educating individuals, families, and communities about autism spectrum disorder (ASD). Autism Health provides educational programs, workshops, events, research, and resources tailored to meet the diverse needs of those impacted by autism and other neurological disorders.
DONATE HERE (https://autismhealth.com/donations/?mc_cid=1abc1b8d41&mc_eid=UNIQID)
Autism Health Inc. depends on generous donations from our community. Large or small, every donation gets us closer to achieving our goals. We are grateful for your assistance! For more information about Autism Health, visit www.AutismHealth.com

But if you already understand how important this race and your support are, and you’re ready to become a Founding Donor to our campaign, please use this link to split a contribution today: | | [CONTRIBUTE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123258574/594864141/-1544561244?refcode=email_011326_peltola&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTU5MWE1Yi1iMWYwLWYwMTEtODE5NC0wMDBkM2ExMWY5MDMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uWk39IjWqytwnPmKJW9n18LBckex43I2BOXF2QEZilc=)
---
Now here’s a bit more on how I came to this decision.
When I was growing up in Bethel, salmon fishing with my father in the summers and dog mushing in the winters, Alaska was a place of abundance.
Now, all across Alaska, we have scarcity.
Multi-national companies are trawling our waters and decimating our fish stocks. The moose, caribou, and migratory birds that used to fill our freezers are harder to find.
So we buy more groceries, where the prices are just _crushing_ Alaska families.
And I've got to tell you, DC people do not care that we are paying 17 bucks for a gallon of milk. _They don’t even believe us._
They're focused on their own wallets — not ours.
And when they actually work together on something, it’s usually to help themselves. The rigged system in DC is shutting down Alaska and hurting all of us while politicians and their millionaire and billionaire donors feather their own nest.
It’s why our prices are rising, and our heating bills keep going up. All while the health care and services Alaskans rely on get gutted.
I'm done with politicians getting richer while things get tougher here at home.
Systemic change is the only way to bring down grocery costs, save our fisheries, lower energy prices, and build new housing Alaskans can actually afford.
Systemic change is the only way to fill our homes with abundance again.
My agenda for Alaska will always be: fish, family, freedom. These values have been the core values of my campaigns since the very beginning.
But if we’re going to secure Alaska’s future, we need another priority: fighting corruption.
I'm running for Alaska's Senate seat because it is the fight for our future.
[**This is going to be one of the closest Senate races of the next election, and I cannot do this alone. There is only one way we’ll be able to win this race... and that is together.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123258575/594864142/-1131834303?refcode=email_011326_peltola&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTU5MWE1Yi1iMWYwLWYwMTEtODE5NC0wMDBkM2ExMWY5MDMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uWk39IjWqytwnPmKJW9n18LBckex43I2BOXF2QEZilc=)
So I am asking:
[_**Please contribute to my campaign for the U.S. Senate and Andrea Salinas today to become a Founding Donor. We are looking for a huge number of day one donors to get our campaign off to a strong start and put us in a position to win. No donation is too small. They will all add up fast.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123258576/594864143/-1131834303?refcode=email_011326_peltola&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTU5MWE1Yi1iMWYwLWYwMTEtODE5NC0wMDBkM2ExMWY5MDMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uWk39IjWqytwnPmKJW9n18LBckex43I2BOXF2QEZilc=)

The rigged system in DC is shutting down Alaska and hurting all of us while politicians and their millionaire and billionaire donors feather their own nest. It’s why our prices are rising, and our heating bills keep going up. All while the health care and services Alaskans rely on get gutted. I'm done with politicians getting richer while things get tougher here at home. Systemic change is the only way to bring down grocery costs, save our fisheries, lower energy prices, and build new housing Alaskans can actually afford. Systemic change is the only way to fill our homes with abundance again. My agenda for Alaska will always be: fish, family, freedom. These values have been the core values of my campaigns since the very beginning. But if we’re going to secure Alaska’s future, we need another priority: fighting corruption. #
Friend, this is a different kind of email than I usually send. I’m not asking for a donation today. **Instead, I’m asking you to personally endorse my re‐election campaign as we head into what’s shaping up to be the toughest race of my career.** We’re officially in the election year, and MI‐08 is rated as one of the most competitive districts in the country. Your endorsement - today - sends a powerful message that we’ve got the grassroots strength to win and continue delivering for working families. [**We’re aiming to add 500 names to our list of endorsers to kick off 2026 on strong footing -- and it would mean a lot if you were one of them. Will you endorse today?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123259422/594867305/-814608335?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZWE1ZWUxYS1iM2YwLWYwMTEtODE5NC0wMDBkM2ExMWY5MDMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Saa4Zvnn6o4rfkXuv6K31sTFGz395-ClhCz8RgBjAds=&emci=31548814-b3f0-f011-8194-000d3a11f903&emdi=8ea5ee1a-b3f0-f011-8194-000d3a11f903&ceid=27257697) | [Add your name](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123259423/594867333/-814608335?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZWE1ZWUxYS1iM2YwLWYwMTEtODE5NC0wMDBkM2ExMWY5MDMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Saa4Zvnn6o4rfkXuv6K31sTFGz395-ClhCz8RgBjAds=&emci=31548814-b3f0-f011-8194-000d3a11f903&emdi=8ea5ee1a-b3f0-f011-8194-000d3a11f903&ceid=27257697)
---
Adding your name is quick -- but it carries real weight.
It shows the national GOP that this isn’t a seat they can take lightly. It shows our neighbors that we’re not just in this race -- we’re in it to win it. And it builds momentum for the fights ahead.
MAGA Republicans are pushing policies that would double health care costs for working families, slash critical programs like Medicaid and SNAP, and make it harder for people to afford basics like groceries, prescriptions, and rent. My job is to push back against those cuts, fight for an economy that works for everyone, and protect the progress we’ve already made.
And that’s exactly why this seat matters so much.

Over the weekend, I was proud to stand with SEIU-USWW members and labor leaders at a gubernatorial candidate forum at a critical moment for our state and our country.
What is happening in our nation right now needs to end. Immigrant communities are being targeted, fear is being weaponized, and working class families are under attack by Donald Trump’s extremist agenda. I am running for Governor to continue fighting for California, protect our immigrant communities, and stand up for the workers who make our state strong.
Working families deserve dignity, respect, and real economic security. That means being able to afford groceries and gas, access reliable and affordable healthcare, and earn fair wages!
This fight is personal to me. I grew up in poverty, relied on public assistance, and worked low-wage jobs to get by. As the son and grandson of immigrants, I know what it means to fight for opportunity and security.
Throughout my career, I have delivered real results for working families. As a legislator:
* I earned a 100 percent pro-worker record [https://www.tonythurmond.com/accomplishments] and passed laws to hold employers accountable for wage theft.
* Strengthened workplace safety protections, expanded overtime pay for farmworkers, and supported skilled, union-built jobs.
* As Superintendent of Public Instruction, I have stood shoulder to shoulder with educators and school workers, supporting collective bargaining, fair pay, and safe working conditions.
I am running for governor to make sure California works for the people who keep our state running every day!

Every one of us lives with tension - the tug-of-war between the two of us living in all of us. In DIVIDED, Pastor Jackson Lahmeyer gets real, raw, and deeply relatable as he opens up about his own struggles with pride, anger, and failure while chasing God's purpose. Through humor, honesty, and hard-learned wisdom, Lahmeyer invites readers to drop the mask, confront the "dark me" that keeps surfacing, and experience the transforming power of grace. This is not a polished preacher's pep talk-it's a gut-level, heart-to-heart conversation about what it means to follow Jesus when life gets messy. Drawing from the lives of biblical characters like Peter, Jacob and Paul, Lahmeyer shows that even the greatest heroes of faith had moments of weakness, doubt, and defeat. He unpacks the difference between remorse and repentance, explores how belief shapes behavior, and reveals how identity-not effort-is the key to lasting transformation. With vivid stories, relatable honesty, and the truth of Scripture, he reminds us that God isn't looking for the perfect version of you-He's after the real you. Because the moment you get real with God is the moment He starts making you new. If you've ever felt like you're living two lives-the public you that looks strong and the private you that's barely hanging on-this book is for you. DIVIDED will help you see that failure isn't final, temptation isn't sin, and your past doesn't disqualify your purpose. You'll laugh, you'll be challenged, and you'll find hope in the God who meets you where you are but never leaves you there. Honest, gritty, and full of grace, this book will inspire you to feed the right wolf, renew your mind, and finally live as the "you" God designed you to be.

body:
Y’all, it’s Jasmine.
I’m reaching out with big news, and I wanted you to hear it from me first: I’m officially running for the United States Senate here in Texas.
Let me be clear: With our current wannabe dictator in the White House, I’m not launching this campaign to play nice. I’m doing it to fight — because Texas deserves someone who doesn’t back down when the bullies come for her. It deserves someone who fights back.
But to win this race, we’ll have to take on Donald Trump, the Texas Republican political machine, and all of their shady special interest donors. And to be blunt, that won’t come cheap.
That’s why I’m asking you to become one of my founding donors as we launch this historic grassroots campaign. I’m counting on your support now more than ever before so that we can hit the ground running and finally flip Texas blue. Will you answer the call by splitting a donation between my campaign and Real Texas? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jasmine?refcode=011326_2]

Let me be clear: When there’s a fight worth having, I don’t flinch. I don’t shrink. I don’t back down.
Just ask the communities I’ve fought for as a civil-rights attorney, the defendants I’ve represented as a public defender, and the people of Dallas that I serve in Congress. I’m a lifelong fighter for justice.
So Donald Trump can run his mouth all he wants. All his attacks show is that he’s terrified of what I represent — and what I’m bringing to the Senate when we win this race: truth, accountability, and a future where power answers to the people.
If you believe that insults won’t silence us — if you believe in a Texas that stands for justice, equity, and real representation — I need you. We’re launching a campaign to change the game. | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123259670/594868239/-903348368?refcode=EM_BNCC_LEE_250113_FR_Results_A0_na_U1_X1_M1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MjA5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MzEzNjE5OC1iM2YwLWYwMTEtODE5NC0wMDBkM2ExMWY5MDMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wI46LhthCDmvCSybdVHzflP1TMKm-KZyrbIX8J0dKYg=) Friend, I want to take a moment to share something important — because in a moment when Washington feels chaotic, I believe results still matter. This week, the House passed my bipartisan **Help Hoover Dam Act** — legislation I introduced with Senator Catherine Cortez Masto to finally unlock **$50 million in long-stranded funding** to maintain and modernize Hoover Dam. That means:
* **Lower energy costs**
* **Protected water resources**
* **Saved taxpayer dollars**

Hoover Dam powers homes across Nevada and the Southwest and supplies water to **25 million people**. As it approaches its 100th anniversary, maintenance costs are rising — but instead of asking taxpayers for more, this bill cuts through red tape and puts existing funds to work. That’s what I came to Congress to do: **solve problems and deliver real results for Nevada families.** But here’s the reality. I was re-elected by **less than 2.8%** , and Republicans have already spent **nearly $500,000 attacking me** before this election cycle has even fully begun. They know this seat — and control of the House — will come down to districts like ours. While I’m focused on delivering results, they’re focused on tearing down progress. name: Pennsylvania Working Families Party
subject: Taxing billionaires in PA starts TONIGHT — join us!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pennsylvania Working Families Party
body:
| | | Peter, Across Pennsylvania, families are struggling with bills for groceries, heat, rent, and childcare. The cost of a decent life keeps rising while our paychecks barely budge. Federal budget cuts are starting to take effect this year. Public services like healthcare, schools, and transit are consistently on the chopping block. These cuts will make basic necessities even more expensive. We don’t have to accept this false choice at a time when billionaires are making more money than ever. **That’s why we’re launching “Tax Billionaires, Fund PA,” a new effort to make the ultra-wealthy pay their fair share.** [**Sign up here to join our first organizing call to launch “Tax Billionaires, Fund PA” tonight at 6:00 PM.**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.v2UrIOJHHKkg0Pk-aGvhy_TtrWBBAnh9vPhfXW55SOYJbs4UkOgVYzt8AGOsvCuM1vI9DNojZmbLqP9ZZQVvRMBau6jRj00oacSSGVO6aqQ6X14Z0CpEdY3v2Lx30-nw8g3XAZJ4BY5cbvPgNpKHWBMuQ7DeBWIgZtMB6YoTvjDLA-2Fqc77pg4_IHGeNFp-IjVRuxHqfEeRxe-kXqjf4PHIg9r2ZejK_vneME0EDNMKXHn2S5bCHVBYXgDc7V-mgTlgdbUyJTJQAm_SO5PSlbW0Xfk41dn65SL-5C9xLA5CHH80NUZu59AneAXQmHfX9QxraOMcn48AxrkvFKvRDsqo1IPQeKX5FHT8egWyOpuYex0lGskkMYzLgUKeTvq15c2kWVHv2SfbtwUyEgWXvQ/4n9/YjrWJSp-RfOo4TvM6HnGfQ/h0/h001.cvDxne4MrA4qRcgUROQmyfPaZazpiJf99g3NAeXYo5I) **[Join the call →](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.v2UrIOJHHKkg0Pk-aGvhy_TtrWBBAnh9vPhfXW55SOYJbs4UkOgVYzt8AGOsvCuM1vI9DNojZmbLqP9ZZQVvRDyqpFAVeshCFYoewOvPcBY1biQZT-BOuTwVyPOFTsRnl1nm3Ve1SxpIgVGgEGk01ap-3RvCHJtYzCcXllEiRE46UFC3Y-PNP64_atKfO6PxOfanpLXyq2QrHiXa93MrKsSy-Z08Uk_CAOEfphy4FX2uV3zR8dFRmcDdfoJ2V3DMPgDHwQUJclgOnfasKGp-wu8m15rYaJIbRkD84OhveCMAEO3gI4yBJKM8S8hYaURMRef5oa3JkbU7zhXllrtYQcNBWk6gy8BmaFaHhzJQVnS0iApbNlcZMAiXt8xSDxRcPleAN6zDdtWYZYNuY6MGlg/4n9/YjrWJSp-RfOo4TvM6HnGfQ/h1/h001.7W-oZEOXQ0ar33yGYJACrTOfD8UGVxZvr_xmo9JgXao)** Thanks to President Trump’s “Big Beautiful Bill, our state will lose billions of dollars in revenue beginning this year. Essential services that require state funding will be gutted, unless the legislature comes up with new sources of revenue. **We don’t have to accept cuts to critical services. We can raise more revenue by taxing the richest Pennsylvanians, providing enough funding to expand services, not cut them.** Our plan includes three pieces of legislation:
* **Close corporate tax loopholes:** If a business operates in Pennsylvania, it should pay its fair share in taxes. No exceptions.
* **Pass a digital ad tax:** Big tech companies like Google, Amazon, Meta, and TikTok rake in huge profits from ads that clutter our screens. It’s time they pay sales taxes like other smaller businesses do.
* **Tax Pennsylvania’s billionaires:** The wealthiest Pennsylvanians earn millions every day without lifting a finger. By taxing income from stocks, real estate, trusts, and royalties, we could generate billions.

clean_body: | | | Peter, Across Pennsylvania, families are struggling with bills for groceries, heat, rent, and childcare. The cost of a decent life keeps rising while our paychecks barely budge. Federal budget cuts are starting to take effect this year. Public services like healthcare, schools, and transit are consistently on the chopping block. These cuts will make basic necessities even more expensive. We don’t have to accept this false choice at a time when billionaires are making more money than ever. That’s why we’re launching “Tax Billionaires, Fund PA,” a new effort to make the ultra-wealthy pay their fair share. Thanks to President Trump’s “Big Beautiful Bill, our state will lose billions of dollars in revenue beginning this year. Essential services that require state funding will be gutted, unless the legislature comes up with new sources of revenue. We don’t have to accept cuts to critical services. We can raise more revenue by taxing the richest Pennsylvanians, providing enough funding to expand services, not cut them. Our plan includes three pieces of legislation: Close corporate tax loopholes: If a business operates in Pennsylvania, it should pay its fair share in taxes. No exceptions. Pass a digital ad tax: Big tech companies like Google, Amazon, Meta, and TikTok rake in huge profits from ads that clutter our screens. It’s time they pay sales taxes like other smaller businesses do. Tax Pennsylvania’s billionaires: The wealthiest Pennsylvanians earn millions every day without lifting a finger. By taxing income from stocks, real estate, trusts, and royalties, we could generate billions. Taxing billionaires starts now. In solidarity, Pennsylvania Working Families Party Become a Working Families Party Member!** Other political groups have corporate donors. We have you. . body:
El Paso County District Attorney Michael Allen Announces Run for Colorado Attorney General
| | | | [](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
| | Hi friends,
Listen to today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.joinrmv.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.joinrmv.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.joinrmv.). Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** A Denver audit found the Office of Social Equity and Innovation [failed to implement nearly half of required financial reforms](https://link.email.joinrmv.), putting youth detention funds at risk, while the EPA ruled Colorado overstepped federal law by using haze rules to [force coal plant closures](https://link.email.joinrmv.) critical to grid reliability. As the National Western Stock Show delivered a [$175 million economic boost](https://link.email.joinrmv.), the DEA warned cartels see Colorado as a [safe haven under permissive drug policies](https://link.email.joinrmv.). Politically, El Paso County DA Michael Allen [launched an attorney general bid](https://link.email.joinrmv.) focused on public safety, as [Mesa County officials pushed back](https://link.email.joinrmv.) against being forced to manage the fallout from state energy policies they didn’t create.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** New developments raised serious questions about government accountability as a Michigan court dismissal revealed [officials acted without legal authority](https://link.email.joinrmv.) in an election-related raid, shifting scrutiny to state and county leaders. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent also [warned federal fraud could total $600 billion annually](https://link.email.joinrmv.), draining taxpayer dollars through widespread abuse and weak oversight.
**🗣️ Commentary Spotlight...** A new commentary [scrutinizes the unelected legislative fellows](https://link.email.joinrmv.) advising Colorado lawmakers, warning that evasive answers, vague claims of impartiality, and limited transparency risk allowing nonprofit-driven priorities to quietly shape policy. The piece urges voters to remain vigilant and hold both lawmakers and their advisers accountable.
This is your Mountain Minute for Tuesday, January 13, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[El Paso County District Attorney Michael Allen Announces Run for Colorado Attorney General](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
District Attorney of El Paso County Michael J. Allen has declared his intention to run for attorney general in Colorado.
Allen served in the Navy and is in his second term as district attorney for Colorado’s Fourth Judicial District. His announcement comes as the state grapples with rising auto theft, higher insurance costs, and continued overdose deaths.Allen framed the decision as a gradual one.
Allen framed the decision as a gradual one.
“It was a long time coming to make the decision,” Allen said. “I’ve had people reaching out to me really starting January of 2025 — both statewide, local folks, and then even national folks — trying to talk me into running.”
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
**[Counties told to fix energy policy they didn’t create: Mesa commissioner pushes back](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Counties blamed for state-made energy policy:** Mesa County Commissioner JJ Fletcher says counties are being forced to manage the fallout from Colorado’s rapid electrification push—higher bills, outages, and public anger—even though they have no authority over utilities, the grid, or state regulatory timelines.
* **Rural economies and schools at risk:** Fletcher warns that moving away from natural gas threatens local tax bases, noting energy producers supply more than 80% of the property tax revenue for some rural school districts, leaving essential services vulnerable if drilling declines.
* **Reliability gaps exposed:** Citing recent winter power shutoffs and infrastructure limits, Fletcher argues Colorado is abandoning reliable natural gas faster than replacement energy sources can come online, leaving counties to answer for failures they didn’t create.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
The Rocky Mountain Voice is a 501(c)(3) that exists to promote informed civic engagement and the principles of self-governance through enterprise reporting on public policy, politics, government, and culture throughout the state of Colorado. The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
|
---
**[EPA Says Colorado Overstepped Law By Using Haze Rules To Close Coal Plants](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **EPA blocks Colorado’s coal shutdown plan:** The EPA ruled Colorado violated the Clean Air Act by using regional haze rules to force coal plant closures, saying the state prioritized climate goals over federal law.
* **Grid reliability takes priority:** Federal officials said Colorado’s coal plants are still needed to maintain grid reliability, directly challenging the state’s push to replace them with solar, wind, and battery storage.
* **Regulatory uncertainty ahead:** By rejecting Colorado’s entire haze plan, the EPA warned the state’s broader pollution rules could be stuck in regulatory limbo for years, disrupting energy planning and investment.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
[**Strategy First: Obey Before You Engage**](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[****](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | JANUARY 11** Before acting, consider who is guiding you—God or man. The divine plan or human influence. Or, good versus bad influence. We live in a world that prizes action. People, society, and negative influences often push us with “make the move,” urging us to take a shot, trust our instincts, and do what feels right.
[**The War Within: Why 2026 Isn’t About Doing More—But Surrendering First**](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[****](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | JANUARY 11** _New year. New theme. New direction... But before anyone rushes into new goals, habits, or spiritual disciplines, let’s slow down and be honest for a moment. Because if we’re not careful, we’ll treat Christianity like a software update—something that boosts performance without changing ownership. And that’s not the faith Jesus called us into._
__
[**One of these scenes is not like the other!**](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[****](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**BY RUSS MINARY | COMMENTARY | JANUARY 6** _A protest is going on. In Scenario One, a woman starts to enter a secure area via a broken window. An officer inside the secure area, pulls his gun and shoots the woman dead. In Scenario Two, a woman has been obstructing officers in their duty to enforce the law. The woman, using her car as a weapon, drives her vehicle toward the officer, hitting him — and being shot dead by the officer._ ____

Hi Peter, it’s Dawn Moore, First Lady of Maryland.

I know you get a lot of asks in your inbox. But please remember that our situation is unique in Maryland. Starting January 14th, Wes can’t raise a cent until April!

subject: This creed is the foundation
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jason Crow for Congress
body:
Jason Crow For Colorado [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/88523/images/Screenshot%202025-08-21%20at%2010.50.41%E2%80%AFAM.png]
Hi there, serving in the United States Army was one of the greatest honors of my life. I’ve never forgotten the creed I lived by when I served as an Army Ranger:

“My country expects me to move further, faster, and fight harder than any other.”
“I will shoulder more than my share of the task, whatever it may be, 100% and then some.”
“Under no circumstances will I ever embarrass my country.”

My service taught me a lot about respect, working under pressure, and the value of selfless service to others.

As a leader, it was on me to set an example — to be the last one to eat, the first one to jump out of the plane, and model the behavior I expected from others.

Right now, our president is the antithesis of this creed. He’s called for members of Congress — including me — to be imprisoned and killed, all for speaking out about his extremism.

He’s weaponizing the FBI against me, launching bogus federal inquiries against those who are putting the oaths we swore to the Constitution over the whims of this president.

I signed up to serve to protect our rights and freedoms. I ran for office to make a difference in people’s lives. Now more than ever, it’s clear: we need more leaders who are ready to do the hard work to defend the rule of law against all odds.

| | For months, Portlanders have felt intimidated by the troops and federal agents deployed on our streets by the Trump administration. **I said from the start that Trump's reckless actions to instill fear would only put lives in danger.** Our community is reeling from the news this past week of two people shot by federal law enforcement, just hours after the entire country grappled with the horrific killing of an unarmed woman in Minneapolis by ICE agents. Trump's federal agents are out of control. We need them _off_ our streets. **Anyone involved in these shootings must be investigated by**** _state and local authorities_****– because Trump officials have made clear they care more about advancing their pre-written narratives than public safety and accountability.** I have already introduced legislation requiring the unmasking of the federal agents who have been intimidating people and violating due process. I will keep demanding answers and oversight as more facts become known in the days ahead about these tragedies. We all deserve the peace of mind to know we can walk home without masked agents sweeping us up at a moment's notice with no due process. We don't deserve to live in fear of being shot because we question a federal agent. We must bring an end to the terror the Trump administration is _deliberately_ instilling. More soon, _Ron_ |

Hi Peter I'm Scott Kelly - former NASA Astronaut, retired U.S. Navy Captain and resident of CO district 4.
I've been to space 4 times and spent nearly a year on the International Space Station (ISS). I commanded both the Space Shuttle and the ISS and flew with more than 40 people from across the world--scientists, engineers, doctors--men and women of every background, faith, and nationality. We didn't share the same backgrounds, but we shared a mission: work together, stay focused, and deliver.
That's the kind of leadership and focus we need in Congress. That's what Trisha Calvarese brings to the table.
I'm proud to endorse Trisha Calvarese in Colorado's 4th District.
Trisha is running to defeat Lauren Boebert - and I'm proud to endorse her in this critical mission.
Trisha grew up here on the rural Eastern Plains and in Douglas County. She served our country as a civil servant and returned home to care for her sick parents at the end of their lives. She understands the people of this district because she's actually one of us. She's running for Congress to stand up for the dignity and care of families in her hometown.
That means protecting Social Security and Medicare. It means working to bring down the cost of everything from prescription drugs to groceries. It means investing again in U.S. science and engineering to create good-paying jobs and opportunities. Trisha's ready to actually show up, listen and deliver for folks in her district.
But while Trisha is advocating for you, Lauren Boebert is spending her time making headlines, avoiding her constituents, and voting to gut the programs Coloradans rely on. That's why I'm counting on you to join me in supporting Trisha's campaign to defeat Boebert.
But grassroots campaigns like this one aren't easy. And right now Trisha is counting on our help to raise the $10,000 she needs to build the early infrastructure it takes to win races like this.
[So, friend, I'm personally asking: Will you chip in $25 or more today to help Trisha Calvarese defeat Lauren Boebert, take back the House for Democrats and give working families the voice they deserve in Congress?](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001uSQK8BGU9P5VkTxmP2SKczyayqhW0Kl9R1b0q950MPun8Iu5rvNZvezXfk5S7IkRJimIYrCaqbYpapDpE5BK6_SGb2vEG0xO0TxvB0ROQPAWYCBJd1x3oDg8M9nwVNovC9KS-QSFQPbU5Nwvsv-ibbRCiomZtcjurzarLlLjIaWRJJjE5qOn8GPt9gG0u1Zq__AsBKSzz9pp4XHVxCc59tyshkmv7bB-CwfPHvTlHmTm9UkloKmlSA==&c=0lkEr35ZvQAt7faNG6fwP3ZhXpX8JbyaepkOdGjx3kj41fz48z6fFQ==&ch=bT7HeD1Uc_5AZbhaCOlsVehmSMaQiYRnt5uLRM0Eo3XoShAbI1DS0w==)

Dear Fellow American,

Chicago Public Schools desperately needs qualified teachers. But school officials are choosing to discriminate against Christian student teachers rather than fill those vacancies.

The students at Moody Bible Institute are experiencing this discrimination firsthand.

Moody's students are barred from participating in Chicago Public School's student-teaching program. Not because they lack qualifications. Not because they lack passion for serving students. But because Moody exclusively hires staff who affirm and live out its biblical beliefs.

**In other words, Chicago Public Schools is punishing Moody students for attending a college that practices its faith.**

This is an attack on religious freedom--one of the foundational freedoms that has shaped our nation since its inception. Religious schools like Moody Bible Institute have the constitutional right to exclusively hire employees who share their faith and uphold their religious mission. Without this right, religious institutions would lose their very identity and purpose.

Moody's mission is clear: proclaim the gospel and equip people to be biblically grounded, practically trained, and to engage the world through gospel-centered living. For that mission to be credible, its faculty and staff must be unified in both belief and practice.

But when Moody requested a simple religious exemption acknowledging its constitutionally protected rights, the district refused.

**Instead, officials doubled down --effectively telling Moody students that their faith disqualifies them from serving Chicago's public school children.**

Alliance Defending Freedom is representing Moody Bible Institute in a federal lawsuit to challenge this discriminatory exclusion.

**Will you sign our Statement of Support for Moody Bible Institute and stand with them in this critical moment?
**
This isn't an isolated situation. We are watching this pattern repeat nationwide.

In Washington State, **Yakima Union Gospel Mission** serves thousands of homeless individuals every day--offering food, shelter, and the hope of Christ to locals who desperately need it. Yet the state is threatening the Mission because it only hires those who share its Christian beliefs. Now the Mission is in court seeking to protect its right to hire those who share and live out its faith.

Similarly, in Oregon, Youth 71Five Ministries is asking an appeals court to protect its right to receive public benefits without having to give up its right to employ those who share its faith. Youth 71Five Ministries serves at-risk youth, empowering them with the hope of the Gospel. It depends on a staff that shares its biblical beliefs. But officials stripped the ministry of its public funding for only hiring like-minded individuals who ensure that mission goes forward, violating its constitutional freedoms.

When ministries like Moody, Yakima Union Gospel Mission, and Youth 71Five Ministries stand up in court, they are not only protecting their own freedom. They are defending religious freedom and free expression for every American--Christian or not.

**But these battles come with real emotional and personal costs.** Leaders and staff can face hostility, intense public scrutiny, and even open threats. Stand alongside thousands of believers who are praying for Moody during these stressful times.

That's why your voice matters so deeply right now.

**Please take a moment to sign the Statement of Support today.**

body:

Just like everyone else, I watched the videos of ICE killing Renee Nicole Good in her car last Wednesday. It was sickening.
Renee was just 37 years old (only one year older than me), a poet, and a mother of three. She and her wife, Becca, had recently moved to Minneapolis with their six-year-old son, who they would often drive to school together.
Renee should still be alive today.
Because multiple bystanders were exercising their First Amendment rights by filming ICE’s actions on their cell phones, we all saw her brutal murder with our own eyes — which makes the Trump administration’s immediate and ongoing attempts to gaslight the public and cruelly twist the truth even more outrageous.
We know what we saw and what we heard. This was murder.
When I watched the footage captured by the ICE agent’s cell phone (shared by the White House itself) and heard the words “f***ing b***h” uttered immediately after the fatal gunshots rang out, my blood ran ice cold. Like many women, I recognized that tone immediately.
We demand accountability and justice NOW — and it should go without saying, but in our current dystopian reality, it doesn’t, so let me be extremely clear: “Absolute immunity” for ICE is bullshit.
Over the past year, we’ve seen countless videos of ICE’s unnecessary violence in communities across this country, including San Diego. The horrifying reality is that what happened to Renee in Minneapolis could’ve happened anywhere, to anyone.
It’s easy to feel powerless in these moments, particularly as the administration does everything it can to lie, obscure, and distort reality. But we can’t stay quiet and we can’t back down — we won’t.
Here are several important things we can all do right now to resist ICE’s abuses of power:
* Know your rights, for immigrants : the ACLU has resources in both English and Spanish [https://www.aclu.org/know-your-rights/immigrants-rights] for encountering ICE and being detained or arrested.
* Know your rights, for allies : You have a First Amendment right to film or photograph law enforcement activities in a public space, so long as you’re not interfering or obstructing. If you feel safe to do so, record the activity with your phone and/or write down any relevant information about what you witness. It’s helpful to write down the names and phone numbers of any witnesses and badge numbers of any law enforcement agents. * If an ICE officer, member of the National Guard, or other law enforcement officer tells you to stop filming, depending on your comfort level interacting with law enforcement, you may want to comply with orders, or assert your constitutional rights but continue to film from a further distance.

* Join a group that’s doing work on the ground : Indivisible [https://groups.indivisible.org/] has thousands of groups around the country who are joining together to protest, resist, and support those affected by ICE and CBP’s actions.
* Sign my petition demanding that Kristi Noem resign or be impeached [https://secure.ngpvan.com/Tr9bPooinEmNTEIqncpleg2?contactdata=yJbgAST8mr3hEG8qxdJiO4AdbWgVwkQGOrjaCETGpNVwDG257AsG1zvMkACtgiBqVWjGWqB21nLhgXr/xW0SzK7G3mVeS/MeWC/SQgtoLEtr+shP9rPquWBrk83Q2+TbDQIljfs3TGe5D1m/3iSbFQ==] : Secretary Noem bears the ultimate responsibility for the brutal and unacceptable violence coming from ICE. She must be held accountable and cannot be allowed to continue abusing her power.
* Talk to your friends and family about all of this : Your voice is especially powerful among your own network — more than you may realize! Start conversations, share accurate information, and do what you can to share your own concern with those around you.

And of course, as Democrats in Congress take action on a legislative level, I will be asking for your help to ramp up public pressure on our Republican colleagues.
Thank you for reading and for being a part of this team. We’re living through incredibly challenging times, and staying in community is one of the most important ways for us to get through this.
I’ll keep you updated on our work in the House and in San Diego, and I’d love to hear from you about how you’re navigating all this in your own community.
—Sara

Republicans are holding the House by a very small margin. Everyone in Washington knows it. **Democrats are already counting seats and making plans for what they’ll do if they take control back in 2026.**

Now here’s a bit more on how I came to this decision.
When I was growing up in Bethel, salmon fishing with my father in the summers and dog mushing in the winters, Alaska was a place of abundance.
Now, all across Alaska, we have scarcity.
Multi-national companies are trawling our waters and decimating our fish stocks. The moose, caribou, and migratory birds that used to fill our freezers are harder to find.
So we buy more groceries, where the prices are just _crushing_ Alaska families.
And I've got to tell you, DC people do not care that we are paying 17 bucks for a gallon of milk. _They don’t even believe us._
They're focused on their own wallets — not ours.
And when they actually work together on something, it’s usually to help themselves. The rigged system in DC is shutting down Alaska and hurting all of us while politicians and their millionaire and billionaire donors feather their own nest.
It’s why our prices are rising, and our heating bills keep going up. All while the health care and services Alaskans rely on get gutted.
I'm done with politicians getting richer while things get tougher here at home.
Systemic change is the only way to bring down grocery costs, save our fisheries, lower energy prices, and build new housing Alaskans can actually afford.
Systemic change is the only way to fill our homes with abundance again.
My agenda for Alaska will always be: fish, family, freedom. These values have been the core values of my campaigns since the very beginning.
But if we’re going to secure Alaska’s future, we need another priority: fighting corruption.
I'm running for Alaska's Senate seat because it is the fight for our future.
**This is going to be one of the closest Senate races of the next election, and I cannot do this alone. There is only one way we’ll be able to win this race... and that is together.**

**Donald Trump is in Detroit today.** He's not here for a coney dog. Trump's here because he's trying to save his slim Senate majority - _and he knows he needs to win Michigan to do it._
Trump's visit today coincides with the 2026 Detroit Auto Show, but let's be clear: **Trump doesn 't care about Michigan's auto industry.** If he did, he wouldn't have imposed reckless tariffs and said he "couldn't care less" if auto prices rise.

**Well,**_**I couldn 't care more.**_
During the Great Recession, I helped save 200,000 Michigan jobs as part of President Obama's Auto Rescue Task Force. I love this state, and I've spent my career fighting for Michganders.

So as Trump arrives in Detroit today, spreading lies and drawing attention to this critical race, _including_ from his MAGA megadonors, I'm asking you to stand with me.
My team has set an emergency $20,000 goal to send Trump a powerful message and fight back against the surge of right-wing super PAC cash following him into Michigan. **Will you pitch in now to help us hit this urgent goal and keep Michigan blue?**
[ Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/e7db9dd7-daef-4a3b-a14a-d7c6ac05dd5e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
With grit,
Haley
* * *

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?

body:
[ https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/51612?refcode=jtk318-fr-fl-header&t=1001&akid=10535%2E434096%2E5GqHeD ]John Fetterman

Hey folks – it’s John, and I have a question for you.

It's a little different from what I normally ask. Here’s why:

PA is ground zero for 2026.

Four U.S. House seats are in play (more than any other state), and control of the state legislature is on the line. That means who writes the laws. Who calls the shots. And whether Democrats or extremist Republicans run the show.

We need a strong grassroots team to win. Period. And the best way to build one is by having early, steady support that allows us to strategically budget. It lets us plan. It lets us organize. It lets us take the fight to the ballot box and win.

So here's my question: Will you become one of the 10,000 monthly donors we need before our mid-month deadline Thursday at midnight?

https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/52540?t=1002&akid=10535%2E434096%2E5GqHeD

Planning and organizing works. Just look at what Democrats did a few months ago:

✅ Held our PA Supreme Court majority
✅ Elected Abigail Spanberger governor of Virginia

Hello -

My name is Mary Peltola, and I want to share with you why I've made the decision to run for the United States Senate in Alaska — and to ask for your support as we begin this journey together.

But if you already understand how important this race and your support are, and you’re ready to become a Founding Donor to our campaign, please use this link to split a contribution today:

---

Now here’s a bit more on how I came to this decision.

When I was growing up in Bethel, salmon fishing with my father in the summers and dog mushing in the winters, Alaska was a place of abundance.

Now, all across Alaska, we have scarcity.

Multi-national companies are trawling our waters and decimating our fish stocks. The moose, caribou, and migratory birds that used to fill our freezers are harder to find.

So we buy more groceries, where the prices are just _crushing_ Alaska families.

And I've got to tell you, DC people do not care that we are paying 17 bucks for a gallon of milk. _They don’t even believe us._

They're focused on their own wallets — not ours.

And when they actually work together on something, it’s usually to help themselves. The rigged system in DC is shutting down Alaska and hurting all of us while politicians and their millionaire and billionaire donors feather their own nest.

It’s why our prices are rising, and our heating bills keep going up. All while the health care and services Alaskans rely on get gutted.

I'm done with politicians getting richer while things get tougher here at home.

Systemic change is the only way to bring down grocery costs, save our fisheries, lower energy prices, and build new housing Alaskans can actually afford.

Systemic change is the only way to fill our homes with abundance again.

My agenda for Alaska will always be: fish, family, freedom. These values have been the core values of my campaigns since the very beginning.

But if we’re going to secure Alaska’s future, we need another priority: fighting corruption.

I'm running for Alaska's Senate seat because it is the fight for our future.

**This is going to be one of the closest Senate races of the next election, and I cannot do this alone. There is only one way we’ll be able to win this race... and that is together.**

So I am asking:

subject: Checking in on our community + glimmers of hope
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Morrison for Congress
body:
https://kellyforcongress.org [https://kellyforcongress.org]
Hi Peter,
Congresswoman Kelly Morrison here. I’m reaching out to check in with our community after an extremely heartbreaking week. Like you, I am devastated and outraged by the influx of ICE agents Trump has sent to our state, and the horrific killing of Renee Nicole Good in front of her wife in broad daylight by ICE agents on Wednesday.
I’ve said it already but it bears repeating: ICE must leave Minnesota immediately before more people get hurt.
On Saturday, alongside my colleagues Congresswomen Ilhan Omar and Angie Craig, we visited the Whipple Federal Building in Minneapolis to do our constitutional duty and perform Congressional oversight on the detention center. We arrived at the building to a large number of armed federal agents, and we were briefly allowed in before being abruptly removed from the building. I give a detailed rundown of our experience [https://x.com/atrupar/status/2010030900201804230] here [https://x.com/atrupar/status/2010030900201804230] [https://x.com/atrupar/status/2010030900201804230] :
Screenshot of Kelly on the news with the title [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP59/1/109390/images/screenshots/26-news-whipple.png]
When we were informed that we had to leave the detention center, I made a direct plea to the commanding ICE agents. I told them about the immense trauma Minnesota has been through over the past year. I explained how the massive surge of DHS agents is provoking fear and chaos in our state, and that if we were able to provide some transparency to our constituents, it could help lower the temperature and provide some reassurance to our communities.
They shrugged off my pleas and refused.
I asked to see the conditions the detainees were experiencing. It is my duty as a member of Congress - and as a physician - to make sure their basic needs are being met. Once again, we were rebuffed by the ICE agents.
Peter, this is a watershed moment for our country. An unaccountable secret police force whose mission increasingly appears to be to create terror and to provoke confrontation is roaming our streets, and is making us less safe. I will not stop fighting for my constituents – and all Minnesotans – and their rights. I am back in Washington, and ready to work to stop the terror this Administration is inflicting on our communities.
I love Minnesota. In spite of the tragedies our communities have endured this past year, the kindness and resilience of Minnesotans continue to inspire me. We show up for each other: from attending peaceful protests across our state to bringing groceries or running errands for their neighbors who do not feel safe leaving their homes. The compassion we extend to one another during this time is what sustains our collective courage.
I was proud to join neighbors at a peaceful protest in Plymouth on Sunday and was so inspired by the estimated 4,000 (!) people who came out on a cold day in January. We will get through this, together. If we are all just a little bit brave, together we can stand up to the authoritarianism of this Administration and save our constitutional republic.
Photo collage of people with protest signs. [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP59/1/109390/images/people/26-plymouth-protest.jpg]
Ours is a remarkable system of government, but it will not survive without engagement and nurturing. So let’s commit - together - to do the work to maintain it. Thank you for your partnership, Peter!
With gratitude and resolve,
Congresswoman Kelly Morrison

body:

| | | | [](https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/f4802f2b03f04295b17e0d300ecc5416-f8ab30dfac5a4eb89051d842f4e9bd2f/63)

| | Friend,
I feel like I'm at a complete loss. After meeting with leadership, I realized the full scope of the threat we face, and it's heartbreaking. I'm came home distraught, and decided I had to write down the truth for the one person I trust most: **you.**
Our Majority, and more importantly, President Trump’s future, is hanging by a thread. A _**_single Senate race_**_ will decide if the liberals block every single thing he tries to do. If we lose, he is finished.
The stakes are overwhelming. I won't be able to look him in the eye knowing I didn't do absolutely everything to keep every seat.
Friend, I am appealing to you now, _not as a Senator,_ but as a conservative who has nowhere left to turn. The only way I can possibly move forward is if you read my confidential note, understand the danger, and take action.
Please, please, click the link below now. The time for deliberation is over. We need you to save the Majority.
[**Please Read My Private Note (Keep This Confidential):**](https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/f4802f2b03f04295b17e0d300ecc5416-f8ab30dfac5a4eb89051d842f4e9bd2f/63)

With a heavy heart and unwavering determination,
Katie Britt US Senator

[](https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/f4802f2b03f04295b17e0d300ecc5416-f8ab30dfac5a4eb89051d842f4e9bd2f/63)
---
I didn’t run for Senate to sit quietly on the sidelines. I’m a mom, a conservative, and a proud Alabamian—and I came to fight for the values that make America strong.

_**Faith. Family. Freedom.**_

The Left is doing _everything_ they can to tear it all down. But I didn’t come to Washington to play games. I came to fight for the people who feel forgotten, overlooked, and ignored.

From securing the border to protecting our kids and defending our way of life—I’m in this for the long haul.

**This fight isn’t easy, but it’s worth it. And I’m not going anywhere.**

Will you stand with me?
---

**Peter, 2026 is no ordinary election year. ** It’s a pivotal chapter in our fight to preserve our democracy in the midst of a national redistricting crisis. The scale of this moment can feel daunting, but this is what the NDRC was built for. Donald Trump and Republican leaders have made their strategy clear: manipulate congressional maps to rig the midterms and maintain their grip on power. And they’ve succeeded in doing just that in Texas, Missouri, and North Carolina. In the coming weeks, several states may begin mid-decade redraws to try to expand this power grab or level the playing field in response. Just last week, Florida announced a special session for the express purpose of manipulating its map. **We have our work cut out for us — what we do to prepare now can make a massive difference in whether we can stop Republicans from successfully rigging our maps.[With your help, we’ll be able to do everything it takes to fight for fair maps across the country.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123267014/594893752/1128139581?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_StateofPlayExplainer_email_20260113-NDRC-Tier1-StateofPlayExplainer_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260113-NDRC-Tier1-StateofPlayExplainer_&utm_campaign=StateofPlayExplainer&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImM1YjAxNWU3LWNjZjAtZjAxMS04MTk0LTAwMGQzYTExZjkwMyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=8O9QcL92FsQqjwoLXGL_FDE38B4jxOXhGEjDHC4uRuI=)** Here’s the good news: The response to this manufactured crisis is growing louder, and it’s coming from the people. Voters in California overwhelmingly supported a redraw to counteract Texas’s gerrymander. Voters in Virginia and Maryland have shown support for taking similar responsive measures. And when thousands of voters organized in opposition to efforts to gerrymander in Indiana, a bipartisan coalition in the state senate voted it down. **The TL;DR is this:** **Republicans are focused on doing everything they can to redraw congressional maps wherever they can to try to rig the outcome of the midterm elections in their favor.** And we are the only organization that exists explicitly to stop them from pulling it off. ---
| | | | |
---|---|---|---|---
My name is Russell Cleveland.I’ve spent the last several months visiting every corner of the western congressional district of Montana, listening to stories that have confirmed what I already believed to be true: Montanans are terrified. Tariffs are making it harder to put food on our tables, utility bills keep rising, and people are genuinely afraid for the future of our democracy.**This moment requires a leader who knows how to put up a real fight and has the resilience to see it through. I’m ready to lead that charge, and to respectfully ask for your support as I fight for the future of our state.** Now, I’m running to represent Montana’s 1st District in the U.S. House of Representatives because a lifetime of service, shaped by loss and driven by the belief that we can do better, has prepared me for this fight. I grew up on a farm in the Bitterroot Valley, where I learned that you don’t quit when the work gets hard and you don’t leave your neighbor stranded when the snow piles up. That same fighting spirit and resilience that have carried me through life’s toughest challenges will guide how I represent Montana in Congress.Those qualities guided me through my service in the Navy, where accountability was not a slogan but a way of life. They carried me through years of coaching kids, helping them find confidence when life tried to knock it out of them. And they carried me through the hardest fight of all, when my wife, Kate, and I lost our oldest daughter, Madison, to leukemia in 2020.We learned what courage really means watching her fight for her life. We also learned how broken our healthcare system is when we were handed a $300,000 bill just for a month of treatment intended to save her life. No parent should ever face that, and no decent government should turn its back on people at their lowest point.
---
| | | | [Click HERE to view more about Russ’s candidacy for U.S. Congress. ](https://p9t2.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6966c5639ae80902def9aca1&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Freel%2FDSksdqmiEp5%2F%3Figsh%3DcXQ0Mm91NzJ3eG1o&w=67f56f6d32983179ee870b58&c=b_6966c4a667b8117acf8cf947&l=en-US&s=KBXoN3ncDOuaDTT2fBIw7ZpIJAI%3D) |
---|---|---
That’s why I’m running. Because too many hard-working families are being crushed while billionaires get tax breaks and politicians look the other way. This campaign is about doing what’s right, even when it’s hard. It’s about affordable healthcare, fair wages, strong schools, and protecting the land that makes Montana special. It’s about saving our nation from an administration that wants to gut it and sell it for parts. And it’s about remembering who we are: people who work hard, tell the truth, and take care of each other.Western Montana deserves a representative who lives here, who listens and understands their neighbors, and who never walks away from a hard fight.That’s who I am, and that’s how I will serve Montana. As an attorney and a community leader, I’m mindful that many people will turn to you for advice and counsel regarding who to support in this race. My hope is that you will learn more about my candidacy and come meet me next time I’m in town, which will be soon. Thank you for your consideration.Sincerely,Russell ClevelandPS: I’m asking for your help to take this fight to every corner of western Montana. A contribution of $3,500, $500, or even $50 will make an important difference, empowering our campaign with the resources we need to stand up for common sense and what we all know is right. Every donation is an investment that helps us keep this fight going, and for that, I am deeply grateful. There comes a point in every man’s life...
| Dear Fellow Patriot,
---
There comes a point in every man’s life when you wonder how history will remember you.
---
